title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
description: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a turn-based role-playing game with real-time action elements, set in a dark fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France. Players join Expedition 33, a group of volunteers sent on a desperate mission to stop the mysterious Paintress, a being who erases people from existence each year by painting a number. The game blends strategic party-based combat with timing-based attacks, dodges, and parries, emphasizing both planning and reflexes. It features a character-driven narrative, exploration, and a richly stylized visual presentation.

title: Silent Hill 2
description: Silent Hill 2 is a psychological survival horror game following James Sunderland, who receives a letter from his deceased wife and travels to the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill to find her. As he explores the town, he encounters disturbing monsters, unsettling characters, and surreal environments that reflect his guilt, grief, and inner trauma. Widely regarded as one of the greatest horror games of all time, it is known for its atmospheric storytelling, haunting soundtrack by Akira Yamaoka, and deep psychological themes.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
description: Blood and Wine is the acclaimed expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, sending Geralt of Rivia to the vibrant duchy of Toussaint, a land untouched by war and filled with chivalric courts, vineyards, and dark secrets. The expansion adds a new region to explore, a lengthy main questline, side quests, monsters, armor and weapon sets, and the game-changing Grandmaster gear system. Geralt investigates a series of brutal murders tied to an ancient curse and a mysterious vampire threat, uncovering political intrigue and moral dilemmas along the way. Praised for its rich storytelling, memorable characters, and expansive content, Blood and Wine serves as a grand finale to Geralt’s journey.

title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater
description: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater is a stealth-action game set in 1964 during the Cold War. Players control Naked Snake, later known as Big Boss, on a mission deep in the Soviet jungle to rescue a scientist and stop a nuclear threat. The game emphasizes survival mechanics such as camouflage, hunting for food, treating injuries, and managing stamina, alongside the series’ signature stealth gameplay, close-quarters combat, and cinematic storytelling. It is widely regarded as one of the best entries in the Metal Gear series for its emotional narrative, memorable boss battles, and the origin story it provides for several major characters and conflicts in the franchise.

title: Splatoon Raiders
description: Splatoon Raiders is an announced action-adventure spin-off in Nintendo’s Splatoon series. It follows a new gameplay direction focused on exploration and survival-style objectives rather than the series’ traditional competitive turf war matches. Set on the mysterious Spirhalite Islands, the game puts players in the role of a mechanic who teams up with Deep Cut as they investigate the region and uncover its secrets. Nintendo has described it as a new journey for the franchise, emphasizing offbeat exploration, environmental discovery, and a fresh single-player experience. As of the latest official information, the game has been announced for Nintendo Switch 2, but a final release date has not been confirmed.

title: Disney Cory in the House
description: Disney Cory in the House is a side-scrolling action-adventure game for the Nintendo DS based on the Disney Channel sitcom Cory in the House. Players control Cory Baxter as he navigates the White House and other locations, using gadgets, disguises, and mini-game challenges to help manage chaos around the president’s residence. The game features missions tied to the show’s comedic tone, puzzle-solving, item collection, and light platforming elements. It was developed as a licensed tie-in and released exclusively on the Nintendo DS, aiming at younger audiences who enjoyed the television series.

title: Resident Evil Requiem
description: Resident Evil Requiem is an upcoming survival horror game in Capcom’s long-running Resident Evil series. Announced as a new mainline-style entry, it continues the franchise’s focus on tense exploration, resource management, and combat against bio-engineered horrors. The game follows a new story set in the familiar Resident Evil universe, with a strong emphasis on atmospheric horror, cinematic presentation, and modern survival gameplay. Built for current-generation hardware and PC, it is expected to feature high-end visuals, immersive environments, and a blend of action and dread that the series is known for.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
description: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask is an action-adventure game set in the dark, surreal world of Termina. As Link, players must stop the moon from crashing into the land within three in-game days by using time travel, powerful masks, and side quests that alter the fate of the inhabitants. Compared with Ocarina of Time, the game emphasizes a looping time mechanic, character routines, and a more psychological tone, making it one of the series' most distinctive entries.

title: Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne
description: Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne is the official expansion to Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, expanding Blizzard’s real-time strategy game with new campaigns, heroes, units, items, and neutral buildings. It continues the story of Azeroth through multiple races and factions while adding significant multiplayer balance changes and new strategic options. The expansion includes a series of single-player campaigns that follow key characters such as Illidan Stormrage, Arthas, and the Night Elves, and it greatly deepens the lore of the Warcraft universe. The Frozen Throne is widely praised for its polished RTS gameplay, memorable narrative, and long-lasting impact on competitive gaming and custom map communities, including the rise of Defense of the Ancients (DotA).

title: Heroes of Might and Magic III
description: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Restoration of Erathia is a turn-based strategy game with role-playing elements, set in the fantasy world of Enroth. Players build towns, gather resources, recruit heroes, and lead armies on a grid-based map and tactical combat battlefield. The game is known for its deep faction variety, strong scenario design, and highly replayable campaign and multiplayer modes. It became one of the most celebrated entries in the Heroes of Might and Magic series and a long-standing classic of PC strategy gaming.

title: Silent Hill 2: Restless Dreams
description: Silent Hill 2: Restless Dreams is an expanded version of the survival horror classic Silent Hill 2. It follows James Sunderland, who receives a mysterious letter from his deceased wife and travels to the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill in search of answers. As James explores the town and its disturbing environments, he encounters unsettling characters, terrifying monsters, and psychological horrors that reflect his guilt and grief. Restless Dreams adds the "Born from a Wish" scenario, which focuses on Maria, and includes extra content beyond the original release. The game is known for its atmospheric storytelling, haunting sound design, and emotional narrative, and is widely regarded as one of the most influential survival horror games ever made.

title: Gran Turismo 4
description: Gran Turismo 4 is a realistic racing simulation game focused on car collection, tuning, and precision driving. It features hundreds of licensed cars from numerous manufacturers, a wide variety of real and fictional tracks, and multiple modes including GT Mode, Arcade Mode, and Mission Hall challenges. The game emphasizes authentic handling, detailed vehicle progression, and long-term career-style competition, making it one of the most expansive entries in the Gran Turismo series.

title: Metal Gear Solid
description: Metal Gear Solid is a stealth action game following special agent Solid Snake as he infiltrates the nuclear weapons facility on Shadow Moses Island to stop FOXHOUND, a rogue special forces unit, from launching a nuclear attack. Blending cinematic storytelling, stealth-based gameplay, boss battles, and codec-driven exposition, it became a landmark title in modern game design. Directed by Hideo Kojima, the game is known for its tense atmosphere, memorable characters, and fourth-wall-breaking moments.

title: The Last of Us
description: The Last of Us is a story-driven action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic United States devastated by a fungal infection that turns people into aggressive infected. Players follow Joel, a hardened survivor, and Ellie, a teenage girl who may hold the key to humanity’s future, as they journey across dangerous territory and form a deeply personal bond. The game blends stealth, exploration, resource scavenging, and tense combat, emphasizing survival and emotional storytelling. Originally released for PlayStation 3, it became one of the most acclaimed games of its generation and was later remastered and re-released for newer PlayStation platforms and PC.

title: The Last of Us Remastered
description: The Last of Us Remastered is an enhanced version of Naughty Dog’s critically acclaimed post-apocalyptic action-adventure game. Set in a world devastated by a fungal infection, it follows Joel, a hardened survivor, and Ellie, a teenage girl who may hold the key to humanity’s future, as they journey across the United States. The game blends stealth, exploration, resource management, and tense combat against hostile survivors and infected creatures. This remastered edition includes improved visuals, higher-resolution textures, faster frame rates, and all previously released downloadable content, including the Left Behind story chapter and multiplayer content.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone
description: Hearts of Stone is the first major expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, adding a new story centered on Geralt of Rivia and the enigmatic Man of Glass. Set in the lands of Velen and Oxenfurt, the expansion introduces a dark, character-driven questline involving Olgierd von Everec and a deal with supernatural consequences. It expands the game with new main and side quests, challenging enemies, new gear, and additional gameplay systems such as Runewords that modify weapons and armor. Known for its strong writing and memorable choices, Hearts of Stone offers roughly 10 to 15 hours of content and deepens the world and lore of The Witcher universe.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is not a separately announced or released official version of Xenoblade Chronicles 2 as of my latest knowledge. The original Xenoblade Chronicles 2 is a massive Japanese-style role-playing game set in the Cloud Sea, where the protagonist Rex and his companion Pyra journey across the titanic living world of Alrest in search of Elysium. The game features real-time combat with Blade companions, a broad open-world structure, party-based progression, and a sweeping story centered on exploration, alliances, and the conflict between nations and powerful beings. If this title is intended to refer to a hypothetical enhanced edition for Nintendo Switch 2, no verified public release details are available.

title: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos
description: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos is a fantasy real-time strategy game set in the Warcraft universe. Players command one of four factions—the Humans, Orcs, Undead, or Night Elves—while managing resources, building bases, and leading armies across a story-driven campaign. It introduced hero units that level up during battle, adding role-playing elements to classic RTS gameplay. The game is known for its cinematic presentation, memorable characters, and the foundation it laid for the later mod and custom map scene, including Defense of the Ancients.

title: StarCraft: Brood War
description: StarCraft: Brood War is the official expansion to Blizzard Entertainment's classic real-time strategy game StarCraft. Released in 1998, it adds new units, campaign missions, and story content for the Terran, Protoss, and Zerg factions, continuing the conflict across the Koprulu Sector. The expansion is widely praised for its balanced multiplayer design, deep strategic gameplay, and influential competitive scene. Brood War became a landmark title in esports, especially in South Korea, and is still celebrated as one of the greatest RTS games ever made.

title: Age of Empires II: The Conquerors Expansion
description: Age of Empires II: The Conquerors Expansion is an expansion pack for the real-time strategy game Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings. It adds five new civilizations, four new campaigns, additional units, new technologies, and gameplay improvements. The expansion introduced notable features such as the Hispaniola, Aztec, Mongol, Saladin, and Attila the Hun campaigns, alongside new civilizations including the Aztecs, Huns, Koreans, Mayans, and Spanish. It also added the ability to create garrisoned formations, set rally points for town centers and castles, and included balance changes that refined the base game's strategic depth. Widely regarded as one of the most influential RTS expansions, it remains a classic among strategy fans.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is an action-adventure game in which players control Link on a quest to stop Ganondorf from obtaining the Triforce and plunging Hyrule into darkness. Set across a richly connected world, the game combines exploration, puzzle-solving, dungeon crawling, and real-time combat. Its time-travel mechanic allows Link to move between childhood and adulthood, changing the world and story events in significant ways. The game is widely celebrated for its innovative Z-targeting combat system, cinematic presentation, memorable dungeons, and influential design that helped define 3D adventure games.

title: Chrono Trigger
description: Chrono Trigger is a landmark Japanese role-playing game developed by Square. It follows a group of heroes traveling across different eras of history to prevent a global catastrophe and stop the destruction of the world. Known for its time-travel plot, memorable characters, multiple endings, active-time battle system, and art and music by a dream team of creators, the game is widely regarded as one of the greatest RPGs of all time. It blends exploration, turn-based combat, and branching story choices into a highly replayable adventure.

title: Planescape: Torment
description: Planescape: Torment is a story-driven isometric role-playing game set in the Planescape Dungeons & Dragons universe. Players control the Nameless One, an immortal amnesiac who awakens in the city of Sigil and must uncover the mystery of his past lives while navigating bizarre planar realms, philosophical factions, and morally complex choices. The game is renowned for its deep writing, unconventional combat-light design, and emphasis on dialogue, exploration, and character interaction over traditional combat.

title: Resident Evil 4 (2005)
description: Resident Evil 4 is a third-person survival horror game in which Leon S. Kennedy is sent to a remote rural village in Europe to rescue the U.S. president’s daughter, Ashley Graham. The game shifts the series toward more action-focused combat while retaining tension, resource management, and horror elements. Players fight infected villagers and mutated enemies, solve puzzles, upgrade weapons, and protect Ashley through varied environments including villages, castles, and laboratories. It is widely regarded as one of the most influential and acclaimed games of its era.

title: Planescape: Torment
description: Planescape: Torment is a story-driven isometric role-playing game set in the Planescape campaign setting of Dungeons & Dragons. Players control the Nameless One, an immortal man awakening in the city of Sigil with no memory of his past and a body covered in mysterious scars. The game emphasizes dialogue, choice, and character interaction over combat, with quests often resolved through conversation, exploration, and creative problem-solving. Its narrative explores identity, mortality, and redemption, and is widely regarded as one of the most acclaimed RPGs ever made.

title: Chrono Trigger
description: Chrono Trigger is a classic role-playing game developed by Square and originally released for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. It follows a group of heroes who travel through time to prevent a global catastrophe caused by the monster Lavos. The game is known for its time-travel story, multiple endings, memorable characters, and innovative battle system that combines active-time combat with team-based special attacks. It was created by a celebrated development team including Hironobu Sakaguchi, Yuji Horii, and Akira Toriyama, and is widely regarded as one of the greatest video games of all time.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is an action-adventure game that follows Link as he journeys across Hyrule to stop Ganondorf from obtaining the Triforce and plunging the world into darkness. Armed with the Ocarina of Time, Link can manipulate time, solve intricate dungeons, and explore a vast, interconnected world filled with memorable characters, puzzles, and combat. The game introduced Z-targeting, context-sensitive controls, and a cinematic 3D adventure structure that became highly influential on future games. Widely regarded as one of the greatest video games ever made, it blends exploration, dungeon design, and storytelling into a landmark experience for the Nintendo 64.

title: Gothic II: Gold Edition
description: Gothic II: Gold Edition is a classic single-player action RPG set in the dark fantasy world of the Gothic series. It includes Gothic II and the Night of the Raven expansion, adding new quests, characters, areas, and a higher level of challenge. Players continue the story of the nameless hero as he rises from humble beginnings, joins factions, explores dangerous open-world regions, and battles humans, beasts, and ancient magical threats. The game is known for its immersive world, difficult combat, faction-based progression, and strong emphasis on exploration and character development.

title: Half-Life 2
description: Half-Life 2 is a first-person shooter set in the dystopian City 17, where player Gordon Freeman joins a resistance movement against the alien Combine occupation. Building on the original Half-Life, the game combines fast-paced combat, physics-based puzzles, and atmospheric storytelling with the Source engine's advanced facial animation and realistic environments. Players use the iconic Gravity Gun, a wide arsenal of weapons, and environmental objects to solve problems and fight enemies. Widely praised for its narrative, level design, and technical innovation, Half-Life 2 is considered one of the most influential video games ever made.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is an open-world action game set in the early 1990s in the fictional state of San Andreas, which is based on California and Nevada. Players control Carl "CJ" Johnson, who returns to Los Santos after his mother’s death and becomes drawn into gang warfare, corruption, crime, and personal struggle as he tries to rebuild his life and protect his family. The game is known for its huge map, varied missions, character customization, driving and shooting mechanics, and role-playing elements such as stamina, weight, and skill progression. It became one of the most influential and best-selling games of its era.

title: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix
description: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix is an arcade-style open-world racing game focused on illegal street racing across large urban environments. Players compete in high-speed races, time trials, and other event types while customizing licensed cars and motorcycles with performance upgrades and visual modifications. Remix expands on Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition with additional vehicles, more music, and extra races and challenges, including content inspired by other entries in the series. The game emphasizes fast, accessible driving, aggressive traffic-dodging, and route memorization, with a strong soundtrack and extensive vehicle roster that includes cars from manufacturers such as Cadillac, Dodge, Mitsubishi, and Nissan. Its multiplayer modes and deep customization helped make it a standout of the genre.

title: God of War II
description: God of War II is a hack-and-slash action-adventure game and the sequel to God of War. Players again control Kratos, the Spartan warrior turned God of War, as he is betrayed by Zeus and stripped of his power. Seeking revenge, Kratos embarks on a brutal quest through Greek mythology, battling gods, titans, and monsters while solving environmental puzzles and using a wide range of combat abilities. The game is known for its cinematic presentation, fast-paced combat, large-scale boss fights, and dramatic story.

title: Pokemon HeartGold Version
description: Pokémon HeartGold Version is a role-playing game and enhanced remake of Pokémon Gold, originally released for the Game Boy Color. Set in the Johto region, players begin as a young Pokémon Trainer and journey to collect Gym Badges, defeat the Elite Four, and stop the criminal organization Team Rocket. The game features updated graphics, touch-screen support, and the Pokéwalker accessory, which lets players transfer Pokémon and earn experience by walking with the device. HeartGold also includes the ability to have the lead Pokémon follow the player in the overworld, a fan-favorite feature inspired by Pokémon Yellow. After completing the Johto storyline, players can travel to the Kanto region for a second adventure, making it one of the series' largest and most content-rich entries. The game emphasizes exploration, collection, turn-based battles, and trading between versions to complete the Pokédex.

title: Persona 4 Golden
description: Persona 4 Golden is an enhanced version of Persona 4, blending dungeon-crawling RPG combat with life simulation elements. Set in the rural town of Inaba, the story follows a high school student who arrives for a year and becomes involved in investigating a series of mysterious murders linked to the TV World. Players balance everyday school life, friendships, part-time jobs, and social links with turn-based battles, Persona fusion, and exploring randomly generated dungeons. Golden adds new story content, an additional social link, improved visuals, voice work, quality-of-life changes, and new gameplay features, making it one of the most acclaimed entries in the Persona series.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D is a Nintendo 3DS remake of the classic action-adventure game originally released for the Nintendo 64. It follows Link’s journey across the land of Hyrule as he travels through time to stop Ganondorf from obtaining the Triforce and plunging the world into darkness. The remake features enhanced 3D visuals, improved character models and textures, updated touchscreen inventory management, a redesigned boss challenge mode, and refined controls tailored to the 3DS hardware. It preserves the original game’s iconic dungeons, puzzles, and exploration while making the experience more accessible and visually polished for modern players.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Baldur's Gate 3 is a critically acclaimed party-based role-playing game set in the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Players create a custom character or choose an origin hero, then explore the Forgotten Realms while building a party, making story-altering choices, and engaging in deep tactical turn-based combat. The game features branching quests, extensive companion interactions, and strong replayability through its reactive narrative and multiple outcomes. It is known for its cinematic presentation, freedom of approach, and faithful use of D&D 5th Edition-inspired mechanics.

title: Metal Gear Solid HD Collection
description: Metal Gear Solid HD Collection is a remastered compilation of classic stealth-action games from Hideo Kojima’s Metal Gear series, updated in high definition for modern consoles. The collection includes Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater, and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker, with improved visuals, widescreen support, and updated controls for smoother play. Each game delivers a mix of tactical espionage, cinematic storytelling, and elaborate boss encounters, with players relying on stealth, camouflage, and strategy rather than direct combat. The collection also includes bonus content such as digital comics and achievement support, making it a comprehensive way to experience some of the most acclaimed entries in the franchise.

title: Bloodborne: The Old Hunters
description: Bloodborne: The Old Hunters is an expansion for Bloodborne that adds a substantial new chapter to the game’s gothic horror world. Set in the Hunter’s Nightmare, it introduces new areas, weapons, armor, and enemies, along with several challenging boss encounters. The expansion deepens the lore surrounding the hunters who came before and the tragic history tied to the Healing Church and Byrgenwerth. Known for its high difficulty and aggressive combat, The Old Hunters is widely regarded as one of the best DLC expansions of its generation, offering new ways to fight and revealing more of Bloodborne’s unsettling story.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world action RPG based on Andrzej Sapkowski’s Witcher novels. Players control Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter searching for his adopted daughter Ciri while navigating a war-torn world filled with political intrigue, dangerous creatures, and moral choices that shape the story. The game features expansive exploration, real-time combat, alchemy, character progression, and numerous branching quests. It is widely praised for its storytelling, world design, and memorable side content, and it includes major expansions: Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine.

title: Stellar Blade
description: Stellar Blade is a third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic future where humanity has retreated to a colony in space after Earth is overrun by hostile creatures called the Naytiba. Players control Eve, an elite soldier sent to reclaim the planet, as she battles through ruined cities, hostile environments, and powerful bosses. The game combines fast-paced combat, evasive movement, and precise parries with light exploration, RPG-style progression, and collectible upgrades. Developed by Shift Up, Stellar Blade is known for its striking visual presentation, cinematic style, and demanding combat encounters.

title: Half-Life: Alyx
description: Half-Life: Alyx is a first-person VR shooter set between the events of Half-Life and Half-Life 2. Players control Alyx Vance as she and her father Eli lead a resistance against the alien Combine occupation of Earth. Built from the ground up for virtual reality, the game emphasizes immersive interaction, puzzle-solving, exploration, and combat using realistic physics, gravity gloves, and improvised weapons. It is widely praised for its atmospheric storytelling, technical polish, and innovative VR gameplay, and it helped define modern AAA virtual reality experiences.

title: Ghost of Tsushima
description: Ghost of Tsushima is an open-world action-adventure game set during the Mongol invasion of Tsushima Island in 1274. Players control Jin Sakai, a samurai forced to abandon traditional honor-bound combat to become the Ghost, using stealth, deception, and guerrilla tactics to defend his home and people. The game blends cinematic sword combat, exploration, and side quests across a beautifully rendered feudal Japanese landscape. It is known for its striking art direction, wind-guided navigation system, and emotional story about sacrifice, identity, and resistance.

title: Pikmin 2
description: Pikmin 2 is a real-time strategy adventure game in which players guide Captain Olimar and Louie as they explore a mysterious planet to recover treasure for their company’s debt-ridden Hocotate Freight. Building on the original Pikmin, the game expands the formula with two playable leaders, more Pikmin types, underground cave areas, and a stronger emphasis on collecting treasure rather than managing a strict day limit. Players command small plant-like creatures called Pikmin to battle enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and transport objects back to the ship. The game is known for its strategic depth, charming art style, and challenging cave exploration.

title: Rome: Total War
description: Rome: Total War is a real-time strategy and turn-based tactics game set during the rise of the Roman Republic and Empire. Players manage a faction on a strategic campaign map, handling diplomacy, trade, religion, construction, and army movement, while battles are fought in large-scale real-time combat featuring infantry, cavalry, siege weapons, and naval forces. The game is known for its blend of grand strategy and tactical warfare, allowing players to conquer and control territories across the ancient Mediterranean world. It was originally released for PC and later brought to mobile platforms in an enhanced version by Feral Interactive.

title: Super Mario Galaxy
description: Super Mario Galaxy is a 3D platform adventure game in which Mario travels across a series of small planets and galaxies to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser. The game uses gravity-based movement, allowing players to run around spherical worlds, leap between floating platforms, and explore creative space-themed environments. Mario collects Power Stars by completing platforming challenges, solving light puzzles, and defeating enemies. It introduced motion controls through the Wii Remote, including spin attacks and pointer-based actions. Widely praised for its inventive level design, orchestral music, visuals, and polished gameplay, it is considered one of the best platformers ever made.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials and Tribulations
description: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials and Tribulations is the third main entry in Capcom’s Ace Attorney visual novel adventure series. Players control defense attorney Phoenix Wright as he investigates crime scenes, gathers evidence, and battles eccentric prosecutors in dramatic courtroom trials. The game centers on a set of interconnected cases featuring a deeper look into Phoenix’s past, including the return of key characters such as Mia Fey and the introduction of memorable new rivals and clients. Known for its clever writing, emotional story arcs, and twist-filled mysteries, it builds on the series’ investigation and cross-examination mechanics with a strong focus on character drama and courtroom logic. Originally released in Japan for the Game Boy Advance, it later appeared on Nintendo DS and was subsequently ported to multiple modern platforms in various compilations and remasters.

title: Banjo-Kazooie
description: Banjo-Kazooie is a 3D platform-adventure game following Banjo, a bear, and Kazooie, a wisecracking bird who lives in his backpack. Together they explore Gruntilda’s lair and a series of colorful worlds, collecting Jiggies, musical notes, and other items to progress through the game. Players solve light puzzles, battle enemies, and unlock new moves as they search to rescue Banjo’s sister Tooty from the witch Gruntilda. Known for its bright art style, clever humor, memorable music, and tightly designed collectathon gameplay, Banjo-Kazooie became one of the defining titles of the Nintendo 64 era.

title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
description: Crash Bandicoot: Warped is a 3D platform-adventure game in which players guide Crash and Coco through time-traveling stages across prehistoric, ancient Egyptian, medieval, underwater, and futuristic settings. As the third main entry in the series, it expands the formula with varied gameplay styles, including standard platforming, vehicle levels, jet-ski sections, flying stages, and vehicle combat. Players collect Wumpa Fruit, gather power-ups, and defeat enemies and bosses while using new abilities like the double jump and body slam. The game is widely regarded as one of the best titles on the original PlayStation and is known for its polished level design, humor, and replay value.

title: Xenogears
description: Xenogears is a Japanese role-playing game set in a sprawling science-fiction and fantasy world. Players follow Fei Fong Wong as he uncovers his mysterious past while becoming entangled in political conflicts, ancient technology, and a deep story involving religion, identity, and human history. The game features turn-based combat on foot and in giant humanoid mechs called Gears, with an emphasis on combo-based martial arts attacks and strategic resource management. Known for its ambitious narrative, complex themes, and memorable soundtrack, Xenogears is widely regarded as a cult classic of the original PlayStation era.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
description: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker is an action-adventure game set in a vast flooded world where islands replace much of the old land. Players control Link as he sails the Great Sea aboard the King of Red Lions, exploring dungeons, solving puzzles, battling enemies, and searching for pieces of the Triforce to rescue his sister and confront Ganondorf. The game is known for its distinctive cel-shaded art style, expressive characters, and emphasis on ocean exploration. It introduced the Wind Waker baton, which lets Link control the wind and other musical functions to navigate and progress through the adventure.

title: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings
description: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings is a real-time strategy game set in the medieval era. Players choose from a variety of historical civilizations and build economies, train armies, and advance through the Ages while managing resources such as food, wood, gold, and stone. The game features a long single-player campaign based on historical events and figures, as well as competitive multiplayer battles. It is widely praised for its balanced civilization design, strategic depth, and engaging progression system, and it became one of the most influential RTS games ever made.

title: Banjo-Kazooie
description: Banjo-Kazooie is a 3D platform adventure game in which players control Banjo, a friendly bear, and Kazooie, his bird companion, as they journey through colorful worlds to rescue Banjo’s sister Tooty from the witch Gruntilda. Developed by Rare, the game is known for its collectible-focused exploration, humorous writing, varied moveset, and memorable level design. Players navigate hub areas and themed worlds, collecting musical notes, jigsaw pieces called Jiggies, and other items to unlock new areas and progress through the adventure. The game became one of the defining platformers of the Nintendo 64 era and is widely praised for its charm, music, and polished gameplay.

title: Crash Bandicoot: Warped
description: Crash Bandicoot: Warped is a 3D platform action game in which Crash and Coco travel through time to recover the stolen Crystals and prevent the evil Doctor Neo Cortex and Uka Uka from altering history. Players tackle a wide variety of levels set across different eras, including ancient Egypt, medieval castles, the Great Wall of China, and underwater ruins. The game expands on the series’ signature platforming with new playable mechanics such as vehicle stages, underwater sections, jet-skiing, motorcycle races, and time-trial challenges. It features tighter controls, polished graphics, and a larger move set than its predecessors, along with boss battles and secret levels that reward exploration. Widely praised for its variety, pace, and refinement, Warped is considered one of the standout titles in the original Crash Bandicoot trilogy.

title: System Shock 2
description: System Shock 2 is a science-fiction action role-playing survival horror game set aboard the starship Von Braun. Players awaken from cryogenic sleep to investigate a deadly outbreak caused by a hostile parasitic cybernetic intelligence, SHODAN, while battling mutated crew members and rogue machines. The game blends first-person combat, stealth, hacking, psionic abilities, and character progression through an RPG skill system, creating a tense atmosphere where resources are scarce and choices matter. Widely regarded as a landmark immersive sim, it is praised for its deep systems, environmental storytelling, and oppressive horror atmosphere.

title: Diablo II: Lord of Destruction
description: Diablo II: Lord of Destruction is the expansion to Diablo II, adding new story content, two playable classes, a fifth act, and major gameplay improvements. It introduces the Assassin and Druid, expands the level cap, adds new items and runewords, and features the snowy campaign of Act V as players battle Baal and the forces of the Burning Hells. The expansion is known for deep loot-driven action RPG gameplay, cooperative multiplayer through Battle.net, and lasting influence on the genre.

title: Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn
description: Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn is a classic isometric party-based role-playing game set in the Dungeons & Dragons Forgotten Realms universe. It follows the captured Child of Bhaal and their companions as they escape imprisonment and travel across the land of Amn, facing powerful enemies, political intrigue, and supernatural threats. The game is known for its deep branching dialogue, memorable companions, tactical real-time-with-pause combat, extensive character progression, and rich story-driven quest design. Widely regarded as one of the greatest RPGs ever made.

title: Silent Hill 2: Director's Cut
description: Silent Hill 2: Director's Cut is an expanded edition of the acclaimed psychological survival horror game Silent Hill 2. It follows James Sunderland, who receives a mysterious letter from his dead wife and travels to the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill in search of answers. As he explores the eerie streets and disturbing interiors, he encounters grotesque monsters, cryptic characters, and deeply unsettling visions that blur the line between reality and guilt-driven delusion. The Director's Cut includes additional content, such as the "Born from a Wish" side scenario featuring Maria, along with new endings and extra camera options in some versions. Known for its atmosphere, symbolism, emotional storytelling, and haunting soundtrack by Akira Yamaoka, Silent Hill 2 is widely regarded as one of the most influential horror games ever made.

title: Deus Ex
description: Deus Ex is a first-person action role-playing game set in a near-future cyberpunk world where conspiracy, corporate power, and advanced technology collide. Players control JC Denton, a nano-augmented agent working for UNATCO, as he uncovers a layered global conspiracy involving secret organizations, bioterrorism, and political manipulation. The game is known for its highly flexible mission design, allowing objectives to be approached through combat, stealth, hacking, lockpicking, dialogue choices, and exploration. Player decisions and skill choices shape how levels are completed and can influence story outcomes. Combining immersive sim mechanics with RPG progression, Deus Ex is widely regarded as a landmark title for player freedom, branching narrative design, and its blend of shooting, role-playing, and stealth systems.

title: Metal Gear Solid: The Legacy Collection
description: Metal Gear Solid: The Legacy Collection is a compilation package for the PlayStation 3 that brings together a broad selection of games from the Metal Gear series. It includes Metal Gear, Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake, Metal Gear Solid, Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty HD, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater HD, Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots, Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker HD, and additional bonus materials such as digital graphic novels and a special trophy list. The collection was designed as a celebration of Hideo Kojima’s stealth-action franchise, offering a convenient way for players to experience the series’ key story chapters and modernized HD releases in one package.

title: God of War
description: God of War is an action-adventure game that reimagines the classic series with a more intimate, cinematic story. Set in the realm of Norse mythology, it follows Kratos, the former Greek god, and his young son Atreus as they journey to fulfill the final wish of Kratos’ deceased wife: to spread her ashes from the highest peak in the realms. The game combines brutal, weighty combat with puzzle solving, exploration, and character-driven storytelling. Its over-the-shoulder camera, Leviathan Axe weapon, and emphasis on father-son relationship helped define the reboot’s identity. Released to critical acclaim, God of War won numerous Game of the Year awards and became one of the most celebrated PlayStation titles of its generation.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Red Dead Redemption 2 is an open-world Western action-adventure game set in 1899 during the decline of the American frontier. Players follow Arthur Morgan, an outlaw and member of the Van der Linde gang, as the group struggles against lawmen, rival gangs, and internal conflict after a failed robbery. The game features a vast, detailed world with dynamic weather, hunting, horseback riding, story-driven missions, and emergent exploration. Its narrative focuses on loyalty, survival, and the fading age of the outlaw, and it is widely praised for its writing, realism, animation, and immersive atmosphere.

title: Hollow Knight
description: Hollow Knight is a critically acclaimed 2D action-adventure Metroidvania set in the fallen insect kingdom of Hallownest. Players explore a vast interconnected world filled with challenging enemies, hidden paths, environmental storytelling, and tough boss battles. As a silent, unnamed knight, you uncover the kingdom’s history, gain new abilities, and delve deeper into its haunting depths. Known for its atmospheric art, tight controls, and rich sense of discovery, Hollow Knight blends precise combat with platforming and exploration in a beautifully hand-drawn world.

title: Astral Chain
description: Astral Chain is a sci-fi action game set in a futuristic city called The Ark, where humanity is under attack by otherworldly invaders known as the Chimera. Players take on the role of a Neuron officer who, alongside a customizable Legion—an extradimensional combat partner—uses tactical chain-based combat to investigate anomalies, rescue civilians, and fight back against the threat. The game blends fast-paced melee action, puzzle-solving, exploration, and detective-style investigation. Its dual-character combat system emphasizes coordination between the player and the Legion, allowing for combo attacks, crowd control, and special abilities. Directed by Takahisa Taura and produced by Yusuke Miyata, Astral Chain was praised for its stylish presentation, inventive combat mechanics, and unique cyberpunk aesthetic.

title: Hollow Knight: Voidheart Edition
description: Hollow Knight: Voidheart Edition is the definitive version of Team Cherry’s critically acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. Set in the ruined underground kingdom of Hallownest, players control a silent knight exploring vast interconnected areas, battling challenging enemies and bosses, and uncovering secrets through non-linear progression. The Voidheart Edition includes the original game plus all major free content updates, adding new bosses, quests, abilities, and endings. With precise combat, atmospheric hand-drawn art, and a haunting score, it is known for its deep exploration, demanding gameplay, and rich lore.

title: OMORI
description: OMORI is a psychological horror role-playing game developed by OMOCAT, LLC. Players explore a surreal dream world and a darker real-world setting while guiding a reclusive boy named Sunny and his dream alter ego Omori. The game combines traditional turn-based combat with exploration, puzzles, and branching story elements. Its narrative focuses on friendship, trauma, memory, and mental health, shifting between whimsical and unsettling imagery as the story unfolds.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers
description: Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers is the third major expansion for the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV. It follows the Warrior of Light to the First, a reflection of the Source threatened by the collapse of the Lightwardens and the Flood of Light. Players take on the role of the Warrior of Darkness, exploring new regions such as Norvrandt, Rak'tika Greatwood, Il Mheg, and the Tempest while uncovering the mystery of the Exarch and confronting powerful enemies like Emet-Selch. The expansion raised the level cap, introduced two new jobs—Gunbreaker and Dancer—and added new dungeons, raids, trials, and a major story arc widely praised for its writing, characters, and worldbuilding.

title: Silent Hill 2
description: Silent Hill 2 is a psychological survival horror adventure game set in the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill. Players follow James Sunderland, who receives a letter from his deceased wife and travels to the town to search for her, uncovering disturbing truths about his past and the nature of guilt, grief, and loss. The game is known for its unsettling atmosphere, symbolic storytelling, memorable monsters, and haunting soundtrack by Akira Yamaoka. Its focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and tense combat helped define one of the most acclaimed entries in the survival horror genre.

title: Fire Emblem: Awakening
description: Fire Emblem: Awakening is a tactical role-playing game set on the continent of Ylisse, where the kingdoms of Ylisse and Plegia are threatened by war and the rise of the Fell Dragon Grima. Players command a squad of characters on grid-based battlefields, using turn-based strategy, terrain, class abilities, and support relationships to defeat enemies. The game features deep unit customization through class changes, a marriage and child system that affects character progression, and the ability to build relationships that influence combat performance. Awakening was designed to be more accessible than earlier entries in the series while still offering the challenge and permadeath options the franchise is known for. Its story follows Prince Chrom, the tactician Avatar, and the Shepherds as they fight to protect their homeland and uncover the truth behind recurring conflict. The game was widely praised for its engaging characters, refined gameplay systems, and strong presentation, helping revitalize the Fire Emblem series in the West.

title: Metroid Prime Trilogy
description: Metroid Prime Trilogy is a compilation of the three first-person adventure games in Nintendo’s Metroid Prime series: Metroid Prime, Metroid Prime 2: Echoes, and Metroid Prime 3: Corruption. Released for the Wii, it updates the original GameCube titles and includes Wii Remote and Nunchuk motion controls, along with enhanced presentation and convenience features. Players explore alien worlds as bounty hunter Samus Aran, scanning environments, solving puzzles, uncovering lore, and battling hostile creatures and powerful bosses. The trilogy is widely regarded as one of the best ways to experience the Prime saga, combining atmospheric exploration, combat, and progression-based discovery into one package.

title: Bayonetta 2
description: Bayonetta 2 is a stylish action game following the witch Bayonetta as she fights angels, demons, and other supernatural foes in fast-paced, combo-driven combat. It builds on the original game with refined mechanics, larger set-piece battles, and the signature “Witch Time” slow-motion dodge system. The story sends Bayonetta on a mission to save her friend Jeanne’s soul, leading to over-the-top encounters across diverse locations and massive cinematic boss fights. The game is known for its smooth combat, inventive weapon variety, and high production values.

title: Super Mario Galaxy 2
description: Super Mario Galaxy 2 is a 3D platforming adventure game in which Mario travels across a series of imaginative planets and galaxies to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser. Built around gravity-defying movement, the game expands on the original Super Mario Galaxy with new power-ups, more varied level designs, and the return of Yoshi, who adds fresh traversal and gameplay options. Players collect Power Stars by completing challenges, exploring secret areas, and mastering precision platforming across colorful, compact stages. The game is known for its inventive mechanics, polished controls, and high difficulty compared with many other Mario titles, making it a standout entry in the series and one of the most acclaimed platformers on the Wii.

title: Kingdom Hearts II
description: Kingdom Hearts II is an action RPG that follows Sora, Donald, and Goofy as they continue their journey through Disney-themed worlds and original Square Enix settings. Players battle with the iconic Keyblade while teaming up with familiar Disney and Final Fantasy characters to stop the forces of the Heartless and Organization XIII. The game expands on the series' fast-paced combat with new abilities, Drive Forms, and Reaction Commands, and tells a more complex story that connects to the larger Kingdom Hearts narrative.

title: Super Mario Galaxy
description: Super Mario Galaxy is a 3D platform adventure in which Mario travels across a series of imaginative planets and galaxies to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser. Released for the Nintendo Wii, the game is known for its gravity-defying movement, creative level design, and use of motion controls. Players collect Power Stars, explore diverse cosmic worlds, and use unique power-ups and planet mechanics to navigate space-based challenges. The game was widely praised for its controls, visuals, orchestral soundtrack, and inventive gameplay. It was later re-released as part of Super Mario 3D All-Stars on Nintendo Switch.

title: Rome: Total War
description: Rome: Total War is a grand strategy and real-time tactics game set during the rise of the Roman Republic and Empire. Players manage provinces, armies, diplomacy, economy, and politics on a turn-based campaign map, while battles unfold in real time with thousands of troops on the field. The game features three Roman factions, multiple non-Roman factions, and a historical campaign centered on Rome’s expansion across the Mediterranean and beyond. It is known for its large-scale battles, tactical depth, and detailed portrayal of ancient warfare.

title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door
description: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door is a turn-based role-playing game in which Mario teams up with a cast of unique partners to collect the seven Crystal Stars and uncover the mystery of the Thousand-Year Door in Rogueport. The game blends classic RPG combat with timing-based action commands, paper-themed exploration mechanics, humorous dialogue, and puzzle-solving across diverse areas. Players can switch between Mario and partners, use special abilities in and out of battle, and engage in audience-driven fights that add extra strategy and personality to encounters. Widely praised for its writing, art style, and combat depth, it is considered one of the most beloved entries in the Paper Mario series.

title: Pikmin 2
description: Pikmin 2 is a real-time strategy adventure game developed by Nintendo EAD for the GameCube. A direct sequel to Pikmin, it follows Captain Olimar and his coworker Louie as they return to planet PNF-404 to collect treasure and repay a debt owed by Hocotate Freight. Players command different types of Pikmin, each with unique abilities, to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and gather valuables across varied subterranean caves and surface areas. The game expands on the original with new Pikmin types, a partner character for cooperative-style unit management, and the removal of the day limit, allowing more exploration and strategic planning. It is widely praised for its depth, challenge, and inventive level design.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
description: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD is an enhanced remaster of the 2002 GameCube classic The Wind Waker. Set in a vast ocean world, players control Link as he sails between islands, explores dungeons, solves puzzles, and battles enemies to rescue his sister and confront the evil Ganon. This HD version features improved visuals, updated lighting and textures, faster sailing with the Swift Sail, refined gameplay adjustments, and GamePad support for inventory and map management. It preserves the original cel-shaded art style while modernizing the presentation and streamlining several tedious elements from the original release. The game is widely regarded as one of the most polished and beloved entries in the Zelda series.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials and Tribulations
description: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials and Tribulations is a visual novel adventure game and the third main entry in the Ace Attorney series. Players follow defense attorney Phoenix Wright as he tackles a series of challenging courtroom cases, uncovering contradictions in witness testimonies and gathering evidence to expose the truth. The game introduces memorable new characters, including prosecutor Godot, and expands on the series’ blend of investigation, logic, and dramatic cross-examinations. It is known for its tightly written mysteries, emotional character arcs, and impactful story revelations that connect to earlier entries in the trilogy.

title: God of War III
description: God of War III is an action-adventure game and the third main entry in the God of War series. It follows Kratos as he launches a brutal assault on Mount Olympus, seeking revenge against the gods of Greek mythology after the events of God of War II. Players battle through large-scale mythological environments, solve environmental puzzles, and engage in fast-paced combat using signature weapons such as the Blades of Exile and powerful magical abilities. The game is known for its cinematic presentation, massive boss encounters, and high production values. Originally released for PlayStation 3, it later received a remastered version for PlayStation 4 as God of War III Remastered.

title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky
description: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky is a turn-based dungeon-crawling adventure in which the player becomes a Pokémon and joins a rescue team exploring randomly generated dungeons, recruiting allies, battling wild Pokémon, and uncovering a story about time, destiny, and the fate of the world. It expands on Explorers of Time and Darkness with new story episodes, additional Pokémon, adjusted gameplay balance, and the special ability to play as select partner Pokémon in bonus chapters.

title: Half-Life 2: Episode Two
description: Half-Life 2: Episode Two is a first-person shooter and the second installment in Valve’s episodic continuation of Half-Life 2. It follows Gordon Freeman and Alyx Vance as they escape the collapsing City 17 and travel through the wilderness to the Resistance stronghold at White Forest. The game expands on Half-Life 2’s physics-driven combat and puzzle design, introducing larger outdoor environments, new vehicles, and intense encounters with both Combine forces and alien creatures. Episode Two is known for its story-driven progression, memorable set pieces, and emotional ending that left the series on a major cliffhanger.

title: Resident Evil 4
description: Resident Evil 4 is a third-person survival action game in which player controls Leon S. Kennedy, a U.S. government agent sent to rescue the president’s daughter, Ashley Graham, from a mysterious cult in rural Europe. Departing from the series’ earlier fixed-camera survival horror style, the game emphasizes over-the-shoulder shooting, intense combat, resource management, and exploration. Leon faces infected villagers, grotesque bio-organic enemies, and powerful bosses while uncovering the secrets behind the Las Plagas parasite. Widely acclaimed for its pacing, controls, level design, and influence on modern action games, Resident Evil 4 is considered one of the most important and highly regarded games of all time.

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger
description: Digimon Story Time Stranger is a turn-based role-playing game in the Digimon Story series. Players explore a story centered on time travel and the relationship between the human world and the Digital World, building a team of Digimon to battle in strategic, command-based combat. The game emphasizes collecting, evolving, and training Digimon while uncovering a new narrative adventure with modern presentation and upgraded visuals.

title: Astro Bot
description: Astro Bot is a 3D platforming adventure starring Astro, the PlayStation mascot robot, as he explores vibrant worlds to rescue his stranded crew after a galactic mishap. Players use the DualSense controller’s haptic feedback and adaptive triggers to interact with imaginative environments, solve light puzzles, and face inventive platforming challenges. The game features a strong focus on playful mechanics, fast-paced traversal, and references to PlayStation history through cameo bots and themed worlds. Widely praised for its creativity, polished controls, and charming presentation, Astro Bot serves as a showcase for the PlayStation 5’s capabilities.

title: Half-Life
description: Half-Life is a first-person shooter developed by Valve and released in 1998. Set in the secret research facility Black Mesa, the game follows theoretical physicist Gordon Freeman after a catastrophic experiment triggers an alien invasion and a military cleanup operation. Known for its immersive, story-driven presentation, Half-Life avoids cutscenes in favor of seamless in-engine events and scripted sequences, helping establish a new standard for narrative in shooters. Its tight gunplay, atmospheric world design, and intelligent enemy behavior made it one of the most influential games of its era and a cornerstone of modern first-person shooters.

title: CTR: Crash Team Racing
description: CTR: Crash Team Racing is a kart racing game featuring characters from the Crash Bandicoot universe. Players race through themed tracks, use power-ups and weapons, and compete in single races, time trials, and grand prix-style events. The game is known for its tight handling, challenging drift mechanics, and a battle mode that supports competitive multiplayer.

title: Final Fantasy VII
description: Final Fantasy VII is a landmark Japanese role-playing game following Cloud Strife, a mercenary who joins the eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE to fight the Shinra Corporation, which is draining the planet’s life energy. As the story unfolds, Cloud and his allies uncover deeper mysteries surrounding Sephiroth, a legendary SOLDIER turned antagonist, and confront threats that endanger both the planet and themselves. The game is celebrated for its cinematic storytelling, memorable characters, strategic turn-based combat using the Active Time Battle system, and the Materia customization system that lets players tailor abilities and magic. Originally released for the original PlayStation, it became one of the most influential and commercially successful RPGs of all time.

title: Final Fantasy IX
description:
Final Fantasy IX is a classic fantasy role-playing game set in the world of Gaia, where conflict erupts amid the struggle between kingdoms, a mysterious mist-covered planet, and an ancient threat to existence. The story follows Zidane Tribal, a cheerful thief from the Tantalus Theater Troupe, as he becomes entangled in a kidnapping plot involving Princess Garnet of Alexandria and is drawn into a larger journey with a diverse cast of allies.

Known for returning to the series’ medieval fantasy roots after the more futuristic entries, Final Fantasy IX features active time battle combat, exploration across towns, dungeons, and an expansive world map, and a party-driven narrative emphasizing identity, memory, and mortality. It is widely praised for its charming characters, memorable music, and emotional storytelling.

title: Max Payne
description: Max Payne is a third-person shooter developed by Remedy Entertainment and originally released in 2001. The game follows Max Payne, a former NYPD detective framed for murder after his family is killed by drug addicts on the experimental drug Valkyr. As he hunts through the criminal underworld of New York City for the truth, Max becomes a one-man force of vengeance. The game is best known for its noir-inspired story, graphic novel-style cutscenes, and its signature bullet time mechanic, which lets players slow down time during gunfights for cinematic, tactical combat. Its gritty atmosphere, dramatic writing, and action-focused gameplay made it a landmark title in the genre and a major critical and commercial success.

title: Might and Magic VII: For Blood and Honor
description: Might and Magic VII: For Blood and Honor is a first-person party-based role-playing game set in the fantasy world of Enroth. Players control a custom party of four heroes, choosing among classes and races, and explore a large open world filled with quests, dungeons, towns, factions, and turn-based combat. The story centers on a conflict between the kingdoms of Harmondale and Erathia, with the player’s party drawn into political intrigue, war, and ancient magic. The game features extensive character progression, spellcasting, skill development, and non-linear exploration. It is known for its deep systems, large environments, and classic dungeon-crawling gameplay, and is the seventh main entry in the long-running Might and Magic series.

title: StarCraft
description: StarCraft is a landmark real-time strategy game set in a far-future science fiction universe. Players command one of three distinct factions—the Terrans, Zerg, or Protoss—each with unique units, structures, and strategic strengths. The game is known for its tight balance, fast-paced multiplayer, and highly competitive gameplay, which helped define modern esports. Its single-player campaign follows a conflict across the Koprulu sector as the factions struggle for survival, domination, and identity amid political intrigue and interstellar war.

title: Silent Hill
description:
Silent Hill is a survival horror game that follows Harry Mason, an ordinary man searching for his missing adopted daughter, Cheryl, after a car crash strands him in the eerie fog-covered town of Silent Hill. As Harry explores deserted streets, dark buildings, and nightmarish otherworldly locations, he uncovers disturbing secrets involving occult rituals, cult activity, and the town’s supernatural power.

The game is known for its oppressive atmosphere, psychological horror, heavy fog, and unsettling sound design by Akira Yamaoka, all of which became defining features of the series. Unlike action-focused horror games, Silent Hill emphasizes exploration, puzzle-solving, limited resources, and vulnerability. Its shifting environments and symbolic monsters reflect psychological themes and trauma, helping establish it as one of the most influential horror games ever made.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Price of Loyalty
description: The Price of Loyalty is an expansion for Heroes of Might and Magic II that adds a new campaign, additional scenarios, new creatures, artifacts, and map objects to the original turn-based strategy and fantasy role-playing game. It expands the world of Enroth with four connected campaigns—The Price of Loyalty, Descendants, Voyage Home, and Wizard's Isle—offering more maps, story content, and tactical variety. Players recruit heroes, build castles, manage resources, and command armies in grid-based battles, with the expansion introducing fresh gameplay twists and higher challenge for returning players.

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
description: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty is a stealth-action game directed by Hideo Kojima. Set across two main chapters, it follows newly introduced operative Raiden and series protagonist Solid Snake as they uncover a conspiracy involving the Arsenal Gear weapons platform and the artificial intelligence systems controlling global information and political power. The game is known for its cinematic presentation, complex story, advanced stealth mechanics, and dynamic enemy AI. It introduced features such as first-person aiming, context-sensitive actions, and improved environmental interaction, while expanding on the series’ themes of surveillance, identity, and manipulation. Widely praised for its gameplay depth and technical ambition, it is regarded as one of the most influential titles on the PlayStation 2.

title: Jagged Alliance 2
description: Jagged Alliance 2 is a tactical role-playing game set in the fictional country of Arulco, where players assemble and command a team of mercenaries to overthrow a ruthless dictator. The game combines turn-based, squad-level combat with strategic management, hiring and firing mercenaries, controlling territories, training militias, and managing limited funds and supplies. It is known for its deep tactical gameplay, memorable mercenary personalities, flexible combat options, and strong player freedom in how missions are approached. The game has been praised as one of the best strategy and tactics titles of its era.

title: Final Fantasy X
description: Final Fantasy X is a Japanese role-playing game set in the world of Spira, where a young blitzball star named Tidus joins summoner Yuna on a pilgrimage to defeat the destructive entity known as Sin. The game features a turn-based battle system with a visible turn order, a deep character progression grid called the Sphere Grid, and fully voiced story scenes, which were a major milestone for the series. It is known for its emotional narrative, memorable characters, and distinctive tropical-fantasy setting. Originally released for PlayStation 2, it later received an HD remaster for modern platforms.

title: Populous: The Beginning
description: Populous: The Beginning is a real-time strategy game in the Populous series where the player takes the role of a shaman leading a tribe and competing against rival tribes across a series of 3D planets. Unlike earlier god-game entries in the series, it blends strategic base-building, unit control, and powerful magical abilities. Players can terraform terrain, summon spells, and direct followers in battles to expand their influence and defeat enemies. The game is known for its innovative 3D world, distinctive tribal theme, and emphasis on the shaman as a central combat and support unit.

title: Final Fantasy VII
description: Final Fantasy VII is a landmark Japanese role-playing game set in the dystopian world of Gaia, where the megacorporation Shinra drains the planet’s life energy for power. Players follow Cloud Strife, a former SOLDIER mercenary who joins the resistance group AVALANCHE and becomes entangled in a conflict that spans personal identity, environmental themes, and world-threatening stakes. The game is known for its turn-based combat, materia magic system, memorable cast, cinematic storytelling, and iconic moments such as the tragedy surrounding Aerith. Originally released for the original PlayStation, Final Fantasy VII became one of the most influential and best-selling RPGs of all time, helping bring Japanese RPGs to a global audience. It has since been widely re-released on modern platforms and remains a defining title in gaming history.

title: Command & Conquer
description: Command & Conquer is a real-time strategy game that helped define and popularize the modern RTS genre. Set during a fictional conflict between the Global Defense Initiative (GDI) and the Brotherhood of Nod, players gather resources, build bases, produce armies, and command units in fast-paced battles across a global war. The game is known for its distinctive live-action cutscenes, asymmetric factions, strong multiplayer support, and accessible yet tactical gameplay. It introduced many players to base-building strategy and became one of the most influential PC games of the 1990s.

title: Age of Mythology: The Titans
description: Age of Mythology: The Titans is the official expansion pack for the real-time strategy game Age of Mythology. It adds the Atlantean civilization, introducing new hero-focused gameplay, unique myth units, and powerful Titan mechanics. The expansion also includes a new campaign centered on Arkantos’ son, Kastor, as he navigates conflicts involving the Atlanteans and the rise of a greater threat. Players continue to gather resources, build bases, worship gods, and command armies drawn from mythology, while the new faction and units expand strategic depth and replayability. The Titans also adds new maps, balance changes, and multiplayer options, making it a major enhancement to the original game.

title: Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition
description: Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition is a real-time strategy game and enhanced re-release of Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness and its expansion, Beyond the Dark Portal. It includes support for Blizzard’s Battle.net online service, letting players compete in multiplayer matches over the internet. Set in the fantasy world of Azeroth, the game centers on the ongoing war between the human Alliance and the orcish Horde, with both sides also clashing against demonic and undead threats. Players gather resources, build bases, train armies, and use naval and air units in large-scale tactical battles. The Battle.net Edition also packaged the original game and expansion together, along with various compatibility and multiplayer improvements for Windows PC players.

title: Fire Emblem
description: Fire Emblem, officially titled Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade in the West, is a tactical role-playing game for the Game Boy Advance. It follows Lyn, Eliwood, and Hector as they become embroiled in political conflict, war, and a sinister plot involving dark magic and an ancient threat. The game features grid-based battles, permanent unit death in classic mode, class promotions, and a strong emphasis on story and character relationships. It was the first Fire Emblem title released outside Japan and introduced many players worldwide to the series’ strategic combat and permadeath mechanics.

title: Super Smash Bros. Melee
description: Super Smash Bros. Melee is a crossover fighting game featuring characters from Nintendo franchises and beyond, including Mario, Link, Pikachu, and many more. Players battle on themed stages using attacks, special moves, items, and platforming movement to knock opponents out of the arena. Melee is known for its fast pace, precise controls, large roster, and deep competitive mechanics, which helped make it one of the most celebrated entries in the series. It also includes a variety of single-player modes, multiplayer battles, unlockable content, and a unique trophy collection system.

title: Final Fantasy IX
description: Final Fantasy IX is a classic Japanese role-playing game set in the fantasy world of Gaia. The story follows Zidane Tribal, a cheerful thief, and a diverse cast of companions as they become caught up in a conflict involving rival kingdoms, a powerful sorceress, and the fate of their world. Returning to a more traditional medieval-fantasy style after the futuristic settings of some earlier series entries, the game features turn-based battles, character-specific abilities, and a memorable Active Time Battle system. It is widely praised for its heartfelt story, charming art style, strong character development, and orchestral score. The original PlayStation version launched in 2000, and later remastered releases brought updated visuals and quality-of-life improvements to modern platforms.

title: Metal Gear Solid Integral
description: Metal Gear Solid Integral is an expanded version of Metal Gear Solid featuring the original stealth-action campaign with additional content and refinements. It includes extra VR Missions, a first-person view mode, alternative difficulty options, and numerous gameplay adjustments that make it the most complete PlayStation release of the game. Integral also adds a special “Snake’s Tales” set of side missions in some regional versions, offering new objectives and scenarios built around familiar locations and mechanics. The game follows Solid Snake as he infiltrates a remote nuclear weapons facility to stop the terrorist group FOXHOUND and prevent a nuclear threat. Known for its cinematic storytelling, voice acting, and stealth-focused gameplay, Integral is especially notable for its enhanced replay value and bonus content compared with the original release.

title: Might and Magic VII: For Blood and Honor
description: Might and Magic VII: For Blood and Honor is a first-person party-based role-playing game set in the fantasy world of Enroth. The player leads a group of adventurers through a large open-world campaign filled with towns, dungeons, quests, and faction choices that can affect the story. The game blends exploration, turn-based tactical combat, character development, and extensive class and skill progression. It features both a single-player campaign and a strong emphasis on party customization, allowing players to recruit and train characters across a variety of roles such as warriors, spellcasters, and hybrid classes. As the seventh main entry in the Might and Magic series, it is known for its expansive scope, strategic depth, and replayability.

title: StarCraft
description: StarCraft is a real-time strategy game set in a science-fiction universe where three distinct factions—the technologically advanced Terrans, the psionic Protoss, and the insectoid Zerg—battle for control of the galaxy. Known for its tightly balanced asymmetric design, cinematic campaign, and highly competitive multiplayer, the game became a landmark title in esports and strategy gaming. Players gather resources, construct bases, research upgrades, and command armies across a series of story-driven missions that unfold through the original StarCraft campaign and its acclaimed expansion, Brood War.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time / Master Quest
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time / Master Quest is a GameCube compilation that includes the classic action-adventure game Ocarina of Time along with Master Quest, a rearranged version of the same game featuring altered dungeon layouts and tougher puzzles. Players follow Link on a quest across Hyrule, traveling through time to stop Ganondorf and save Princess Zelda. The package was released primarily as a bonus disc included with The Wind Waker pre-orders in North America and as part of limited-edition bundles in other regions. It preserves the core story and gameplay of the original Nintendo 64 title while offering a more challenging twist for returning players.

title: Resident Evil (Remake)
description: Resident Evil (Remake) is a survival horror game and a ground-up remake of the original 1996 Resident Evil. Set in the eerie Spencer Mansion, the game follows S.T.A.R.S. members Chris Redfield and Jill Valentine as they investigate a series of bizarre murders, only to uncover a deadly conspiracy involving bio-engineered monsters and the Umbrella Corporation. The remake significantly enhances the original with updated visuals, refined controls, expanded environments, new puzzles, additional enemies, and deeper story details, while preserving the tense exploration, limited resources, and puzzle-solving that defined the series. Widely praised for its atmosphere, presentation, and faithful yet improved design, it is considered one of the best remakes in video game history.

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
description: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty is a stealth-action game directed by Hideo Kojima. Set in a tense near-future political thriller, the game follows a covert military operation aboard the tanker Discovery and later the vast offshore Big Shell facility. Players use stealth, gadgets, and tactical planning to avoid detection, disable enemies, and uncover a conspiracy involving information control, artificial intelligence, and global manipulation. The game is known for its cinematic presentation, refined stealth mechanics, environmental detail, and controversial narrative structure that shifts the playable protagonist from Solid Snake to Raiden. It became highly influential for its themes, storytelling, and gameplay innovations in the action genre.

title: Freelancer
description: Freelancer is a space trading and combat action game set in a persistent sci-fi universe. Players take on the role of a freelance pilot navigating an open-ended career of exploration, trading, bounty hunting, and dogfighting across multiple star systems. The game features a campaign-driven story alongside sandbox gameplay, letting players upgrade ships, manage faction relationships, and move between diverse regions with different economies and dangers. Known for its accessible controls, cinematic presentation, and vibrant mod community, Freelancer blends space sim elements with fast-paced action.

title: Half-Life
description: Half-Life is a first-person shooter in which players control Gordon Freeman, a scientist trapped in the Black Mesa Research Facility after a catastrophic experiment opens a dimensional rift. Blending action, exploration, puzzle-solving, and scripted storytelling, the game is known for its immersive, uninterrupted narrative and realistic atmosphere. Players fight hostile aliens, soldiers, and other threats using a varied arsenal while uncovering the facility’s collapse and trying to escape the disaster.

title: Final Fantasy X
description: Final Fantasy X is a role-playing game set in the fantasy world of Spira, where the young summoner Yuna travels with her guardians, including the outsider Tidus, on a pilgrimage to defeat the monstrous force known as Sin. The game is known for its emotional story, fully voiced dialogue, and turn-based battle system that replaced the series’ traditional Active Time Battle mechanics with the Conditional Turn-Based Battle system. It also introduced the Sphere Grid character progression system, allowing flexible customization of abilities and stats. Final Fantasy X was a major technical showcase for the PlayStation 2 and became one of the best-selling and most acclaimed entries in the Final Fantasy series.

title: Max Payne
description: Max Payne is a third-person action shooter developed by Remedy Entertainment. The game follows former NYPD detective Max Payne, who becomes a fugitive after his family is murdered and he is framed for the crime. Driven by revenge, Max battles through a gritty, noir-inspired underworld of drug dealers, mobsters, and corrupt conspirators in New York City. The game is best known for its cinematic storytelling, graphic novel-style cutscenes, and its signature Bullet Time mechanic, which lets players slow down time during firefights for dramatic dodging and aiming.
