Its atmospheric visuals, hardboiled narration, and intense gunplay made it a landmark title in the action genre and helped define modern third-person shooters.

title: Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War
description: Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War is an arcade-style combat flight shooter set in the fictional Strangereal universe. Players take command of the Wardog Squadron as they battle enemy aircraft, ground targets, and large-scale military threats across a globe-spanning conflict. The story follows a squadron of fighter pilots drawn into a mysterious war, blending intense aerial dogfights with cinematic mission structure and squad commands. Known for its polished controls, varied mission design, and dramatic presentation, the game expands on the series’ trademark mix of accessible flight action and military drama.

title: Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3
description: Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3 is a Game Boy Advance remake of Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island, originally released for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. Players control Yoshi and a group of other Yoshis as they escort Baby Mario across a colorful series of platforming stages. Yoshi can flutter jump, throw eggs, swallow enemies, and transform through various stage-specific gimmicks to solve puzzles and defeat bosses. The remake adds enhanced colors, updated sound, and extra features such as a version of the classic Mario Bros. arcade game. It preserves the original’s distinctive hand-drawn art style, inventive level design, and collectathon elements, making it one of the most celebrated platformers on the system.

title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
description: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic is a critically acclaimed role-playing game set thousands of years before the films in the Star Wars universe. Players create and customize a Jedi-in-training who can choose between the light and dark sides of the Force while exploring diverse planets, forming a party of companions, and making story-driven decisions that affect the galaxy. The game features turn-based combat with real-time elements, a memorable narrative twist, and deep character progression. Originally released for Xbox and PC, it has since been brought to modern platforms, helping establish it as one of the most influential RPGs of its era.

title: The Curse of Monkey Island
description: The Curse of Monkey Island is a classic point-and-click adventure game and the third entry in the Monkey Island series. Players follow the continuing misadventures of pirate Guybrush Threepwood, who accidentally causes a curse by giving his beloved Elaine a cursed engagement ring. The game is known for its hand-drawn cartoon art style, voice acting, witty dialogue, and puzzle-driven gameplay. Set across colorful Caribbean islands, it blends humor, exploration, and item-based puzzle solving as Guybrush tries to break the curse, outwit the undead pirate LeChuck, and win back Elaine’s love. It is widely regarded as one of LucasArts’ most polished adventures.

title: The Neverhood
description: The Neverhood is a point-and-click adventure game built entirely from stop-motion clay animation. Players control Klaymen, an amnesiac clay figure exploring a surreal, handcrafted world called the Neverhood to uncover its secrets. The game is known for its quirky humor, imaginative environments, memorable music, and puzzle-driven gameplay. It became a cult classic for its distinctive art style and offbeat atmosphere.

title: Gothic II
description: Gothic II is a third-person action RPG set in a harsh medieval fantasy world. Players return to the island kingdom of Khorinis after the events of the original Gothic and take on the role of the Nameless Hero, who must rebuild his strength, gather allies, and uncover a new threat tied to an ancient evil. The game is known for its challenging combat, open-ended quest design, and immersive world where NPCs follow daily routines and player choices affect progression. Its expansion, Night of the Raven, adds a new region, factions, and additional story content.

title: Astro's Playroom
description: Astro's Playroom is a 3D platformer included with every PlayStation 5 console, designed as both a fun adventure and a showcase for the console's features. Players control Astro, a small robot exploring vibrant themed worlds inspired by different parts of the PS5 hardware and PlayStation history. The game makes extensive use of the DualSense controller, including adaptive triggers, haptic feedback, and the built-in microphone, turning movement and interactions into a tactile experience. Along the way, players collect artifacts and puzzle pieces that celebrate decades of PlayStation consoles, accessories, and iconic characters. It combines accessible platforming, playful presentation, and technical demonstration into a charming tribute to Sony's gaming legacy.

title: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends
description: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is the multiplayer expansion and standalone co-op mode for Ghost of Tsushima. Set in a supernatural version of feudal Japan inspired by Japanese folklore, it lets up to four players team up in story missions and survival challenges, or two players in a raid. Players choose from distinct classes such as Samurai, Hunter, Ronin, and Assassin, each with unique abilities and gear progression. The mode emphasizes cooperative combat, teamwork, and character builds rather than the open-world single-player campaign. Originally released as a free update, Legends later became available as a separate standalone version, offering a focused cooperative action experience with loot, class advancement, and endgame challenges.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker
developer: Square Enix Creative Business Unit III
description: Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker is the fourth major expansion for the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV. It concludes the long-running Hydaelyn and Zodiark storyline, sending players to the moon and beyond as the Warrior of Light confronts new threats tied to the fate of the star. The expansion adds new main scenario quests, two new jobs—Sage and Reaper—new dungeons, trials, raids, and extensive gameplay updates. Endwalker also introduces new areas, adjustments to battle systems, and quality-of-life improvements, continuing the game’s blend of story-driven progression, cooperative PvE, and large-scale online world content.

title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
description: Ori and the Will of the Wisps is a hand-painted action-adventure platformer and the sequel to Ori and the Blind Forest. Players guide Ori through a vast, interconnected world filled with atmospheric environments, challenging traversal, and combat against corrupted creatures. The game expands on the original with refined movement, a deeper combat system, side quests, and a world map that supports exploration and discovery. It is known for its emotional storytelling, orchestral soundtrack, and striking visual presentation. The game follows Ori’s journey to uncover the fate of a lost owl named Ku and restore balance to the land of Niwen.

title: Resident Evil 2
description: Resident Evil 2 is a survival horror game set in the zombie-infested Raccoon City, following rookie police officer Leon S. Kennedy and college student Claire Redfield as they search for answers and try to escape the outbreak. Players explore interconnected locations, solve puzzles, manage limited resources, and fight deadly creatures while uncovering the conspiracy behind the viral disaster. The game is known for its atmospheric tension, dual-scenario structure, and influential design that helped define the survival horror genre. The 2019 remake reimagined the original with modern visuals, over-the-shoulder shooting, and updated mechanics while retaining the core story and tension.

title: Factorio
description: Factorio is a factory-building and automation game where players mine resources, research technologies, construct production lines, and defend an ever-expanding industrial base from hostile alien creatures. Starting with simple hand-crafted machines, you gradually design intricate networks of belts, inserters, assemblers, trains, power systems, and logistics robots to optimize production and launch a rocket. The game emphasizes efficiency, scaling, and creative problem-solving, with both single-player and cooperative multiplayer support.

title: Super Mario Odyssey
description: Super Mario Odyssey is a 3D platforming adventure in which Mario teams up with Cappy, a sentient hat, to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s wedding plans. Players travel across a series of large, open-ended kingdoms, collecting Power Moons to power the Odyssey airship. A core mechanic is Cappy’s capture ability, which lets Mario take control of enemies and objects, creating varied movement, puzzle-solving, and exploration opportunities. The game emphasizes freedom, discovery, and creative platforming, with worlds inspired by real places and classic Mario settings.

title: Astro Bot Rescue Mission
description: Astro Bot Rescue Mission is a virtual reality platformer in which players guide Captain Astro through vibrant levels to rescue his lost crew. Designed specifically for PlayStation VR, the game uses inventive VR mechanics that have players look around environments, lean to discover secrets, and interact with the world in ways not possible in traditional platformers. It is widely praised for its creativity, clever level design, charm, and immersive use of VR.

title: Fire Emblem: Three Houses
description: Fire Emblem: Three Houses is a tactical role-playing game set in the continent of Fódlan, where the Officer's Academy at Garreg Mach Monastery trains future leaders and knights from three rival nations. Players assume the role of Byleth, a mercenary-turned-professor who chooses one of three houses—Black Eagles, Blue Lions, or Golden Deer—to mentor, shaping the story, relationships, and battlefield alliances that unfold over the course of the game. It combines turn-based grid combat with social simulation elements, including instruction, exploration, support conversations, and monastery management. The game is known for its branching narrative paths, deep character development, class customization, and strategic combat.

title: Outer Wilds
description: Outer Wilds is a first-person mystery adventure game set in a compact open solar system trapped in a 22-minute time loop. As an astronaut exploring ancient alien ruins and strange celestial phenomena, the player uncovers the history of the long-vanished Nomai civilization while learning how to navigate planets that change in real time. The game emphasizes curiosity, environmental storytelling, and freeform discovery rather than combat or traditional progression. Each loop reveals new information that helps solve the central mystery and reach the heart of the solar system's secrets.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition is the definitive version of the award-winning open-world RPG, bundling the base game with both major expansions, Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine, plus all additional DLC. Players take on the role of Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter navigating a war-torn, morally complex fantasy world while searching for his adopted daughter, Ciri. The game features vast open-world exploration, branching quests, meaningful player choices, tactical sword-and-magic combat, and monster hunting contracts. The Complete Edition includes quality-of-life updates and, on newer platforms, enhanced visuals and performance improvements, delivering the full Witcher 3 experience in one package.

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is a 2D action-adventure Metroidvania developed by Team Cherry and the sequel to Hollow Knight. Players control Hornet, the agile princess-protector, as she explores the new kingdom of Pharloom, a mysterious land filled with dangerous enemies, elaborate platforming challenges, hidden secrets, and interconnected regions. The game emphasizes mobility, fast-paced combat, acrobatic traversal, crafting, and exploration, with Hornet using a distinct fighting style compared with the original Knight. It features a large cast of characters, quests, and a handcrafted world with atmospheric presentation, demanding boss battles, and deep progression systems. Silksong has been announced for multiple platforms and has been highly anticipated for its expansive scope and refined gameplay direction.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
description: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty is a story-driven expansion for Cyberpunk 2077 set in the dangerous district of Dogtown, a lawless enclave in Night City. Players take on the role of V as they become entangled in a high-stakes espionage thriller involving the New United States, secret agents, political intrigue, and a desperate fight for survival. The expansion introduces a new district to explore, fresh missions, vehicles, weapons, and gameplay systems, alongside a branching narrative with multiple possible outcomes. It also adds a new Relic skill tree and features Idris Elba as Solomon Reed, one of the central characters. Released alongside a major update to the base game, Phantom Liberty is widely regarded as an improvement to Cyberpunk 2077’s core experience, emphasizing espionage, decision-making, and tension-filled combat in a richly detailed cyberpunk setting.

title: Pikmin 4
description: Pikmin 4 is a real-time strategy adventure game in which players explore alien environments, command squads of plant-like Pikmin, and rescue stranded explorers. As the newest entry in Nintendo’s Pikmin series, it adds a more accessible campaign structure, a player-created rescue recruit known as Oatchi’s companion support, and several new mechanics including the ice Pikmin and the Glow Pikmin. Players solve environmental puzzles, collect treasure, battle creatures, and manage day cycles while guiding different Pikmin types with unique abilities.

title: drowning (Rapture)
description: drowning (Rapture) is a hidden-object adventure game in which players investigate a mysterious case involving a young girl and a series of unsettling events tied to a dark, dreamlike world. Set across eerie locations with puzzle-solving and exploration, the game blends narrative-driven adventure gameplay with hidden-object scenes and logic challenges. Players uncover clues, interact with characters, and piece together the truth behind the supernatural occurrences as the story unfolds.

title: Calculator
description: Calculator is a basic calculator application included with early versions of Microsoft Windows and later Windows operating systems. It allows users to perform standard arithmetic operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, along with more advanced functions in later versions. Rather than being a traditional video game, it is a utility program, but it is sometimes listed in game databases due to its software cataloging or placeholder entries. Over time, Calculator evolved from a simple desktop accessory into a more feature-rich tool with scientific, programmer, and graphing modes in modern Windows releases.

title: Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye
description: Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye is the official expansion to Outer Wilds, a first-person exploration and mystery adventure set in a handcrafted solar system. The expansion adds a new, hidden location tied to an ancient signal and introduces a darker, more atmospheric mystery centered on discovery, stealth, and puzzle-solving. Players continue to investigate strange phenomena, uncover forgotten history, and piece together the secrets of an alien civilization while using knowledge-based progression rather than traditional leveling or combat. Echoes of the Eye expands the game’s lore and narrative with new areas, mechanics, and challenges while preserving the original’s sense of curiosity and wonder.

title: God of War Collection
description: God of War Collection is a remastered compilation of the first two God of War games, bundling God of War and God of War II in one package. The collection features upgraded high-definition visuals, smoother performance, and trophy support, bringing the original PlayStation 2 classics to the PlayStation 3 for the first time. Players follow Kratos, a Spartan warrior seeking vengeance against the gods of Olympus, through a mix of brutal combat, platforming, puzzle-solving, and cinematic boss battles. The PlayStation Vita version later added touch-screen and rear touch-pad support. The compilation is widely regarded as one of the best ways to experience the early series and helped introduce the franchise to a new audience.

title: Bloodborne
description: Bloodborne is an action role-playing game set in the gothic, nightmare-filled city of Yharnam, where a mysterious blood plague has transformed much of the population into grotesque creatures. Players take on the role of a Hunter, armed with trick weapons and firearms, and must battle increasingly deadly enemies while uncovering the dark secrets behind the city, the Healing Church, and the source of the scourge. Known for its fast-paced combat, aggressive risk-reward mechanics, and richly layered world design, Bloodborne emphasizes dodging, counterattacks, and relentless pressure over defensive play. The game also features deeply interconnected level design, atmospheric storytelling, and challenging boss encounters that have made it one of the most acclaimed titles on PlayStation 4.

title: Persona 5
description: Persona 5 is a turn-based role-playing game in which players follow a group of high school students known as the Phantom Thieves of Hearts. By day, they live ordinary student lives in modern Tokyo; by night, they explore supernatural dungeons called Palaces, stealing corrupt desires from the hearts of adults who abuse their power. The game blends dungeon crawling, social simulation, and relationship-building, with players managing daily activities, improving character stats, and forming confidants that enhance combat and story progression. Known for its stylish art direction, memorable music, and strategic combat system, Persona 5 became one of the most acclaimed Japanese RPGs of its generation.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
description: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D is a 3D remaster of the Nintendo 64 classic action-adventure game. Set in the mysterious land of Termina, players control Link as he must stop the moon from crashing into the world within a repeating three-day cycle. By using the power of masks, Link can transform into different forms, solve puzzles, explore dungeons, and interact with a cast of characters whose schedules and stories change over time. The 3DS version updates the graphics, improves controls, and reworks several gameplay elements while preserving the original game’s dark atmosphere and time-based structure.

title: Killzone: Mercenary
description: Killzone: Mercenary is a first-person shooter set in the Killzone universe, designed specifically for the PlayStation Vita. Players take on the role of Arran Danner, a mercenary who fights for the highest bidder while navigating the conflict between the Interplanetary Strategic Alliance (ISA) and the hostile Helghast Empire. The game features a full single-player campaign, competitive multiplayer, and support for the Vita’s touch controls and rear touchpad. It is known for delivering console-quality visuals and tight shooting mechanics on a handheld system.

title: Yo-kai Watch 2: Psychic Specters
description: Yo-kai Watch 2: Psychic Specters is an expanded version of Yo-kai Watch 2 that adds new story content, quests, and over 300 collectible Yo-kai. Players explore Springdale and the surrounding areas, battling and befriending mischievous spirits called Yo-kai using a real-time, turn-based battle system centered on the Yo-kai Watch. The game features new areas, additional legendary Yo-kai, the Punifriend minigame, revamped dungeon content, and improved multiplayer features. Psychic Specters also includes the content from both previous versions, Bony Spirits and Fleshy Souls, making it the definitive edition of Yo-kai Watch 2.

title: Red Dead Redemption
description: Red Dead Redemption is an open-world action-adventure game set in the American frontier during the decline of the Wild West era. Players control former outlaw John Marston, who is forced by federal agents to hunt down members of his old gang in exchange for his family's safety. The game blends gunfights, horseback travel, exploration, and side activities across a large, immersive world filled with towns, wilderness, and lawless outposts. It is praised for its story, atmosphere, and detailed world design, and includes a morality system that affects how the world reacts to the player.

title: Factorio
description: Factorio is a construction and management simulation game focused on building automated factories on an alien planet. Players gather resources, research technologies, design production lines, and defend their industrial base from increasingly aggressive native creatures. The game emphasizes logistics, optimization, and large-scale automation, allowing players to create complex systems of belts, trains, robots, and power networks. It supports single-player and multiplayer cooperative play and is known for its deep progression, intricate factory design, and highly polished simulation.

title: OneShot
description: OneShot is a surreal puzzle-adventure game in which you guide a child named Niko through a mysterious dying world to restore its sun. The game is known for its fourth-wall-breaking mechanics, making creative use of the player’s computer or console interface to solve puzzles and progress the story. It features a moving narrative, distinctive pixel-art visuals, and an emotional soundtrack, with choices and actions that can affect the game’s outcome.

title: Bloodborne
description: Bloodborne is an action role-playing game set in the gothic, nightmare-haunted city of Yharnam, where players take on the role of a Hunter investigating a plague tied to blood ministration and monstrous transformations. Developed by FromSoftware, it emphasizes aggressive, fast-paced combat, rewarding offense and quick reactions over defensive play. The game features a dark Lovecraftian atmosphere, challenging bosses, interconnected level design, and deep weapon customization through its Trick Weapon system. Released exclusively for PlayStation 4, Bloodborne is widely praised for its art direction, combat design, and unsettling worldbuilding.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney
description: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney is a visual novel-style legal adventure game that follows rookie defense attorney Phoenix Wright as he investigates crime scenes, gathers evidence, and cross-examines witnesses in dramatic courtroom trials. The player must uncover contradictions in testimony, present the right evidence at the right moment, and solve a series of murder cases to prove their clients' innocence. Known for its memorable characters, witty dialogue, and iconic "Objection!" courtroom confrontations, the game blends mystery solving with light puzzle elements and a strong story-driven structure. It originally launched in Japan for the Game Boy Advance and later became widely popular through the Nintendo DS version, which added touch controls and enhanced presentation.

title: Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening
description: Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening is a hack-and-slash action game and the prequel to the original Devil May Cry. It follows a younger Dante as he opens a mysterious demonic tower, Temen-ni-gru, and battles his twin brother Vergil in a story centered on family conflict, demonic power, and Dante's rise as a demon hunter. The game is known for its fast-paced combat, style-based ranking system, challenging difficulty, and the introduction of selectable combat styles that dramatically change how Dante fights. Its intense boss encounters, deep combo system, and strong presentation made it one of the most acclaimed entries in the series.

title: Astro Bot Rescue Mission
description: Astro Bot Rescue Mission is a 3D platformer built specifically for PlayStation VR. Players control Astro, a small robot captain, as he travels through colorful worlds to rescue his lost crew after their spaceship is attacked. The game uses VR in creative ways, requiring players to look around environments, lean in, and interact with the world to find hidden bots, solve environmental puzzles, and defeat bosses. Its levels feature imaginative set pieces, tight platforming, and a strong sense of depth and scale, making it one of the standout games for the platform. The game was widely praised for its inventive use of virtual reality, charming presentation, and polished gameplay.

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the long-awaited sequel to Hollow Knight, developed by Team Cherry. Players control Hornet, a swift and agile princess-protector, as she is captured and brought to the mysterious kingdom of Pharloom. The game features fast-paced 2D action, acrobatic movement, challenging combat, and extensive exploration through interconnected hand-drawn environments filled with enemies, secrets, quests, and bosses. It builds on the original’s Metroidvania-style design with new tools, crafting systems, and traversal abilities.

title: Jak and Daxter Collection
description: Jak and Daxter Collection is a high-definition remaster of the original Jak and Daxter trilogy developed by Mass Media, Inc. and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. The collection includes Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy, Jak II, and Jak 3, featuring updated visuals, trophy support, and stereoscopic 3D on supported platforms. Players follow Jak and his loyal sidekick Daxter through a series of action-adventure worlds that blend platforming, combat, exploration, vehicle sections, and light puzzle solving. The first game emphasizes open-area platforming and collecting Precursor Orbs, while the sequels expand the formula with darker storytelling, guns, vehicles, and more varied missions. The collection preserves the core gameplay and humor of the original Naughty Dog classics while making them accessible on modern PlayStation hardware.

title: Pokemon Platinum Version
description: Pokémon Platinum Version is an enhanced version of Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, set in the Sinnoh region. Players begin as a new Pokémon Trainer and journey across the region to collect Gym badges, challenge the Pokémon League, and stop Team Galactic’s plans involving the legendary Pokémon Giratina. Platinum introduces the Distortion World, expanded story content, improved gameplay balance, a larger selection of Pokémon, and the Battle Frontier for post-game challenges. It is widely regarded as one of the most polished and content-rich entries in the Pokémon series.

title: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves
description: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves is an action-adventure game following treasure hunter Nathan Drake as he is drawn into a globe-spanning search for the Cintamani Stone and the lost city of Shambhala. Pursued by rival treasure hunters and a ruthless war criminal, Drake teams up with allies Chloe Frazer and Victor Sullivan while navigating dangerous ruins, urban environments, and high-stakes combat. The game is known for its cinematic presentation, third-person shooting, platforming, puzzle-solving, and set-piece sequences, and is widely regarded as one of the defining titles of the PlayStation 3 era.

title: Mass Effect 2
description:
Mass Effect 2 is a science fiction action role-playing game set in the 22nd century, where players take on the role of Commander Shepard, humanity’s elite soldier and N7 operative. After the events of the original Mass Effect, Shepard is recruited by the mysterious organization Cerberus to investigate a devastating threat known as the Collectors, who are abducting entire human colonies. The game focuses on assembling and leading a diverse squad of specialists for a dangerous suicide mission across the galaxy.

Gameplay combines third-person shooting, squad-based tactics, and dialogue-driven choices that shape character relationships and the story’s outcome. Decisions carry over from Mass Effect, and player choices can significantly affect the fate of squadmates and the broader trilogy. Mass Effect 2 is widely praised for its strong character development, cinematic presentation, and streamlined combat, and is considered one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of its generation.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker
developer: Square Enix Creative Business Unit III
description: Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker is the fourth expansion for the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV. It concludes the game’s long-running Hydaelyn and Zodiark storyline while expanding the world with new areas, jobs, dungeons, raids, and an increased level cap. Players travel across Eorzea and beyond, facing the end of days and uncovering the final chapters of the saga through a mix of solo story content and cooperative multiplayer challenges. The expansion introduced the Sage and Reaper jobs, the male Viera playable race, and a broad range of quality-of-life improvements and combat adjustments.

title: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends
description: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is a cooperative multiplayer expansion to Ghost of Tsushima that reimagines the game’s feudal Japan setting through myth-inspired missions and supernatural combat. Players choose from distinct classes and team up in 2-player story missions, 3-player survival mode, and later raid content, battling waves of oni, ghosts, and other enemies drawn from Japanese folklore. The mode emphasizes coordination, class synergy, and gear progression, with each class offering unique abilities and playstyles. Originally released as a free update for Ghost of Tsushima, Legends later received standalone availability and support through Ghost of Tsushima Director’s Cut and Ghost of Tsushima: Legends standalone.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition
description: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition is a remastered version of the acclaimed action RPG Xenoblade Chronicles. It follows Shulk, a young warrior who wields the legendary Monado sword, as he sets out on a journey across the bodies of two colossal titans, Bionis and Mechonis. Featuring a vast open-world structure, real-time combat with party-based abilities, and an expanded soundtrack and visual overhaul, this edition also includes new story content called Future Connected.

title: Calculator
description: Calculator is a general-purpose computing utility rather than a traditional video game. It has appeared in many forms across computers, mobile devices, and dedicated electronic hardware, allowing users to perform arithmetic, scientific, and sometimes programming calculations. While it is not a game in the usual entertainment sense, the title is sometimes included in game lists due to cataloging quirks or placeholder entries. Calculator applications are known for their simplicity, speed, and usefulness in everyday tasks such as budgeting, engineering, and education. Different versions have been shipped by operating system vendors and hardware manufacturers over the decades.

title: Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye
description: Outer Wilds: Echoes of the Eye is the expansion to Outer Wilds, a first-person exploration and mystery adventure set in the same handcrafted solar system. The DLC introduces a new, hidden location and a separate narrative thread centered on a mysterious signal that leads the player to uncover the secrets of an ancient civilization. Like the base game, it emphasizes exploration, environmental storytelling, puzzle-solving, and discovery with no combat-focused progression. Echoes of the Eye expands the universe of Outer Wilds while preserving its time-loop-driven sense of curiosity and discovery.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
description: Super Mario Bros. Wonder is a 2D side-scrolling platformer for Nintendo Switch that reimagines the classic Mario formula with colorful visuals, inventive level design, and unpredictable "Wonder" effects that radically change gameplay. Players can choose from Mario, Luigi, Peach, Daisy, Toad, Toadette, Yoshi, and Nabbit as they travel through the Flower Kingdom to stop Bowser, who has fused with the powerful Wonder Flower and turned himself into a monstrous castle. The game introduces new power-ups such as the Elephant Fruit, bubble-blowing, and drill abilities, along with online features that let players see other players' avatars and helpful ghost-style stand-ins during stages.

title: Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways
description:
Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways is an action-adventure survival horror expansion centered on Ada Wong, running alongside the events of Resident Evil 4. Players experience a parallel story that reveals Ada’s covert mission, her interactions with key characters, and how her actions influence Leon S. Kennedy’s journey. The mode features combat, exploration, puzzle-solving, and item management, with a heavier emphasis on Ada’s agility, gadget use, and stealthier approach compared with Leon’s campaign.

Originally included as an unlockable bonus mode in the PlayStation 2 version of Resident Evil 4, Separate Ways later appeared in other editions and remakes, including as a standalone-style story expansion in Resident Evil 4 (2023). It expands the lore of the main game and adds new areas, enemy encounters, and story scenes that reframe events from Ada’s perspective. The campaign is known for its tighter pacing, additional backstory, and significant role in connecting plot threads involving Ada, Leon, Luis, Krauser, and Albert Wesker.

title: DELTARUNE
description: DELTARUNE is a chapter-based role-playing game created by Toby Fox, best known for UNDERTALE. Players control Kris and a party of classmates and allies as they journey through mysterious Dark Worlds that connect to their everyday life in the town of Hometown. The game blends turn-based combat with bullet-hell dodging, party management, and choices that can change encounters, while emphasizing humor, character-driven storytelling, and emotional themes. Unlike UNDERTALE, DELTARUNE is designed as a separate experience with its own story and cast, though it shares some familiar faces and motifs. Chapters 1 and 2 have been released for free, with later chapters planned as paid content. The game has been praised for its music, writing, worldbuilding, and distinctive battle system.

title: Donkey Kong Bananza
description: Donkey Kong Bananza is a 3D action-platformer starring Donkey Kong, built around fast-paced traversal and large-scale environmental destruction. Players smash through terrain, uncover hidden routes and collectibles, and use DK’s raw strength to battle enemies and overcome obstacles across colorful, expansive stages. The game emphasizes freedom of movement, creative problem-solving, and spectacle, with a focus on banana-themed adventures and cooperative-style momentum through layered environments. It was developed and published by Nintendo for Nintendo Switch 2.

title: Outer Wilds
description: Outer Wilds is an open-world mystery adventure about a solar system trapped in a time loop. As an explorer for the Hearthian space program, the player travels between hand-crafted planets to uncover the fate of an ancient alien civilization known as the Nomai and investigate the cause of the loop that resets every 22 minutes. Progress is driven entirely by knowledge and observation rather than character upgrades or combat. The game emphasizes curiosity, non-linear exploration, environmental storytelling, and puzzle-solving as players piece together clues scattered across planets with unique physics and hazards. Its structure rewards careful observation and experimentation, making each discovery unlock new areas, secrets, and connections in the larger mystery.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
description: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty is a spy-thriller expansion for Cyberpunk 2077 set in Dogtown, a dangerous district of Night City. Players return as V, recruited into a high-stakes mission to save the President of the New United States after her shuttle is shot down. The expansion adds a new story arc, characters, missions, weapons, cyberware, a new Relic skill tree, and vehicle combat elements. It also introduces a redesigned progression system and endgame content alongside the base game update. Phantom Liberty is known for its branching narrative, tense espionage atmosphere, and major choices that can significantly affect the outcome of the story.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition is the definitive version of CD Projekt Red’s award-winning open-world action RPG. Players take on the role of Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter searching for his adopted daughter, Ciri, while navigating a war-torn fantasy world filled with political intrigue, dangerous creatures, and moral choices. The Complete Edition bundles the base game with both major expansions, Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine, along with all previously released DLC. It features a vast seamless world, branching quests, skill-based combat, alchemy, and deep character progression. This edition also includes gameplay and visual enhancements from the next-gen update, depending on platform.

title: Pikmin 4
description: Pikmin 4 is a real-time strategy adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. Players lead a rescue team and a squad of plant-like Pikmin while exploring a mysterious planet, solving environmental puzzles, gathering resources, and battling creatures. The game introduces a customizable Rescue Pup companion named Oatchi, who can help carry items, overcome obstacles, and assist in combat. It also adds a nighttime mode, new Pikmin types, and a more accessible structure than previous entries in the series.

title: Jak and Daxter Collection
description: Jak and Daxter Collection is a high-definition remastered compilation of three classic action-adventure platformers: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy, Jak II, and Jak 3. The collection modernizes the original PlayStation 2 games with upgraded visuals and trophy support while preserving their signature blend of platforming, exploration, combat, vehicle sections, and quirky humor. Players follow Jak and his companion Daxter across a series of interconnected worlds, uncovering ancient secrets, battling enemies, and using an expanding set of abilities and weapons. The collection is known for bringing the full PS2 trilogy to PlayStation 3 and PS Vita in one package for both longtime fans and new players.

title: Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways
description: Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways is a bonus campaign centered on Ada Wong, expanding the story of Resident Evil 4 from her perspective. Originally included in the PlayStation 2 version as an unlockable mode and later featured in various releases, it follows Ada’s covert mission to retrieve the sample of the Las Plagas parasite while intersecting with Leon S. Kennedy’s journey in rural Spain. The campaign adds new areas, unique scenarios, and exclusive gameplay sequences that deepen the main game’s plot and Ada’s role in the events surrounding the Ganado outbreak. It blends third-person action, survival horror, and puzzle-solving, with Ada’s distinct weapons and grappling-hook movement giving it a more agile style than Leon’s campaign.

title: Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition
description: Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition is the complete edition of the critically acclaimed space exploration mystery game Outer Wilds. It includes the base game and the Echoes of the Eye expansion. Players explore a handcrafted solar system trapped in a time loop, uncovering the secrets of an ancient alien civilization known as the Nomai. The game emphasizes curiosity, observation, and non-linear discovery rather than combat or traditional progression. The Archaeologist Edition bundles the full experience for players who want the complete story and all major content in one package.

title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
description: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade is an enhanced PlayStation 5 and PC edition of Final Fantasy VII Remake. It retells the opening section of the 1997 classic in the dystopian city of Midgar, following former SOLDIER operative Cloud Strife as he joins the eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE to fight the megacorporation Shinra. Intergrade features improved graphics, faster loading times, a photo mode, and a new performance mode, along with Yuffie Kisaragi’s bonus episode, INTERmission, which adds a separate story campaign set during the events of the main game. The game blends real-time action with strategic command-based elements and expands the original story with new characterization, combat systems, and narrative details.

title: DELTARUNE
description: DELTARUNE is a chapter-based role-playing game created by Toby Fox, best known for UNDERTALE. Players control Kris and team up with Susie and Ralsei as they travel between the Light World and mysterious Dark Worlds. The game blends turn-based battles, bullet-hell dodging, humor, and story-driven exploration, with a strong emphasis on character interactions and player choice. Unlike UNDERTALE, DELTARUNE uses a party-based combat system and is being released in chapters rather than as a single complete game. The first chapters launched in 2018 and 2021, with additional chapters planned for future release.

title: Donkey Kong Bananza
description: Donkey Kong Bananza is a 3D action-adventure platformer for Nintendo Switch 2 starring Donkey Kong. Players explore a large underground world filled with destructible terrain, hidden routes, collectibles, enemies, and environmental puzzles. The game emphasizes powerful movement, exploration, and smashing through obstacles to uncover new areas and secrets. It was announced as part of Nintendo’s Switch 2 lineup and is one of the system’s major first-party releases. The title features single-player gameplay and showcases the hardware with detailed visuals, expansive levels, and physics-driven interactions centered on Donkey Kong’s strength and agility.

title: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes
description: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes is a first-person action-adventure game in the Metroid series, following Samus Aran as she investigates the doomed planet Aether. After a space pirate conflict and a collision with a dimensional anomaly, Aether is split into a bright Light World and a hostile Dark World, forcing Samus to travel between both realities to survive and solve environmental puzzles. The game expands on the original Metroid Prime with a more combat-focused design, new beam weapons, the Dark Beam and Light Beam, and the unique ammo system tied to them. It is known for its challenging enemies, atmospheric world design, and tense exploration across interconnected regions. Released for the Nintendo GameCube, Echoes was developed by Retro Studios and published by Nintendo. It remains one of the most ambitious and demanding entries in the Metroid franchise.

title: Space Rangers 2: Reboot
description: Space Rangers 2: Reboot is a hybrid sci-fi role-playing game that blends open-world exploration, turn-based combat, trading, text adventures, and real-time strategy elements. Set in a dynamic galaxy threatened by the expansion of hostile robotic Dominators, players can choose different careers such as trader, pirate, bounty hunter, or space ranger while freely exploring star systems, taking missions, upgrading ships, and interacting with factions. The game is known for its huge sandbox structure, emergent events, and unusual mix of gameplay styles, including planetary landings, arcade-style action sequences, and strategy-based battles. Reboot is the international release name of Space Rangers 2 and includes the original game along with the Reboot expansion content.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
platforms: ['Game Boy Advance', 'Nintendo 3DS (via Nintendo 3DS Ambassador Program / Virtual Console availability in some regions)']
description: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap is an action-adventure game in the Legend of Zelda series. Developed by Capcom with supervision from Nintendo, it follows Link as he teams up with the mysterious Minish Ezlo to stop the sorcerer Vaati and restore the Picori Blade. A key mechanic lets Link shrink to the size of the tiny Minish race, revealing new paths, puzzles, and hidden secrets in familiar environments. The game features colorful GBA-era visuals, classic dungeon exploration, sword and item upgrades, and a story set in the kingdom of Hyrule.

title: Knights of Honor
description: Knights of Honor is a medieval real-time strategy game with strong grand-strategy elements, set across Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East. Players take control of a royal family and manage a kingdom through diplomacy, warfare, economy, and dynastic politics. Unlike many RTS games, it emphasizes high-level decision-making, province control, and recruiting noble knights as leaders for armies, spies, merchants, and clergy. The game features a large strategic map, real-time battles, and a flexible system for alliances, crusades, espionage, and trade. Its blend of accessible kingdom management and large-scale medieval conflict made it stand out among early 2000s strategy games.

title: Burnout Revenge
description: Burnout Revenge is an arcade racing game focused on high-speed driving, aggressive takedowns, and causing spectacular crashes. Players compete in intense street races and traffic-heavy events where revenge is a core mechanic: you can target rival cars, slam opponents into obstacles, and build boost by driving dangerously. The game expands on Burnout 3’s signature crash-heavy gameplay with new modes, traffic checking, and enhanced online competition. Known for its fast pace, explosive visuals, and adrenaline-fueled presentation, Burnout Revenge rewards risk-taking and aggressive driving over realistic simulation.

title: The Orange Box
description: The Orange Box is a compilation release by Valve that bundles five games and episodes: Half-Life 2, Half-Life 2: Episode One, Half-Life 2: Episode Two, Portal, and Team Fortress 2. It is best known for delivering a mix of single-player first-person shooting, puzzle-solving, and multiplayer team-based action in one package. Half-Life 2 and its episodes continue Gordon Freeman’s sci-fi story, Portal introduces a unique physics-based puzzle mechanic centered on creating linked portals, and Team Fortress 2 offers stylized class-based multiplayer combat. Widely praised for its value and innovation, The Orange Box became one of the most acclaimed game bundles ever released.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-Earth
description: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth is a real-time strategy game set in J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle-earth and based on the film trilogy directed by Peter Jackson. Players command the forces of good or evil across large-scale battles drawn from The Fellowship of the Ring, The Two Towers, and The Return of the King, building bases, recruiting units, and using heroes such as Aragorn, Gandalf, Saruman, and Sauron. The game features two full single-player campaigns that let you experience the War of the Ring from both sides, along with skirmish and multiplayer modes. It is known for its cinematic presentation, hero-focused gameplay, and large battles that bring the film adaptation to life.

title: Pokemon Emerald Version
description: Pokémon Emerald Version is a third-generation role-playing game set in the Hoenn region. Players begin as a young Pokémon Trainer, choosing a starter Pokémon and traveling across the region to battle Gym Leaders, collect badges, and challenge the Elite Four. Emerald expands on Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire with an updated storyline that features both Team Magma and Team Aqua, while also introducing the Battle Frontier, a post-game facility with multiple challenging battle formats. It includes the ability to catch many Pokémon from earlier games, additional animations and visual refinements, and improved link features for trading and battling. The game is known for its blend of exploration, turn-based battles, and creature collection, and it remains one of the most celebrated entries in the Pokémon series.

title: WWE SmackDown! Here Comes the Pain
description: WWE SmackDown! Here Comes the Pain is a professional wrestling video game featuring the WWE roster from the early 2000s. Players can compete in singles matches, tag team bouts, and several specialty match types, including Hell in a Cell, Elimination Chamber, and backstage brawls. The game is known for its fast-paced arcade-style gameplay, large roster, and deep season mode, where players can guide a wrestler through storylines, rivalries, and championship pursuits. It is widely regarded as one of the most popular and critically acclaimed WWE games on the PlayStation 2.

title: Portal
description: Portal is a first-person puzzle-adventure game set in the mysterious Aperture Science Enrichment Center. Players control Chell, a test subject who must navigate a series of increasingly complex chambers using the Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device, which creates linked portals on flat surfaces. The game emphasizes physics-based problem solving, spatial reasoning, and creative use of momentum to bypass obstacles, traps, and environmental hazards. Guided by the unsettling AI GLaDOS, Portal is known for its dark humor, minimalist storytelling, and iconic companion cube. Originally released as part of The Orange Box, it became widely praised for its innovative mechanics, clever level design, and memorable writing, and is regarded as one of the most influential puzzle games of all time.

title: God of War
description: God of War is an action-adventure game set in Greek mythology that follows Kratos, a Spartan warrior serving the gods of Olympus. Driven by vengeance against Ares, the God of War, Kratos embarks on a brutal quest through ancient lands and mythological horrors. The game combines fast-paced combat, platforming, puzzle-solving, and cinematic set pieces, with a strong focus on visceral melee action using the Blades of Chaos. Praised for its presentation, combat system, and epic scale, God of War became one of the defining PlayStation 2 titles and launched a long-running franchise.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2: Triple Thrill Pack
description: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2: Triple Thrill Pack is a compilation release that bundles RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 with the Wacky Worlds and Time Twister expansion packs. In the game, players design, build, and manage theme parks, constructing roller coasters, flat rides, shops, and scenery while balancing guest happiness, park finances, and park objectives. It expands the classic isometric park-management gameplay of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 with a large set of new rides, scenarios, scenery pieces, and themed content from the two expansions. The game is known for its deep coaster-building tools, detailed park simulation, and highly customizable sandbox-style gameplay.

title: Ape Escape 3
description: Ape Escape 3 is a colorful action-adventure game in the Ape Escape series for PlayStation 2. Players control a pair of heroes, Kei and Yumi, as they use a variety of gadgets to capture mischievous escaped monkeys across themed stages. The game features a playful story, fast-paced platforming, and gadget-based gameplay that builds on the series' signature dual-analog control style. Ape Escape 3 also includes a party-game feature called the Specter TV system, where players can watch in-game programs and unlock content, adding humor and replay value.

title: Kirby's Return to Dream Land
description: Kirby's Return to Dream Land is a side-scrolling action-platformer for the Wii in which Kirby and his friends help a crash-landed alien named Magolor recover the scattered pieces of his ship. Players can inhale enemies, copy their abilities, and use them in cooperative multiplayer for up to four players. The game features colorful 2D stages, boss battles, challenge rooms, and special Super Abilities that temporarily grant Kirby powerful moves to clear obstacles and enemies. It was praised for its classic Kirby gameplay, polished presentation, and accessible co-op play.

title: Batman: Arkham City
description: Batman: Arkham City is an action-adventure game set in an open-world section of Gotham City turned into a massive prison for the city’s most dangerous criminals. Playing as Batman, players use stealth, detective skills, gadgets, and fluid melee combat to stop a sinister plot involving Hugo Strange, the Joker, and other classic DC villains. The game expands on the acclaimed formula of Arkham Asylum with a larger world, more side missions, and a deeper combat and predator system. It is widely praised for its atmosphere, storytelling, voice acting, and faithful portrayal of Batman lore.

title: Mount & Blade: Warband
description: Mount & Blade: Warband is an open-world action RPG set in the medieval-inspired land of Calradia. Players create a custom character and build a faction from the ground up through combat, trading, diplomacy, mercenary work, and conquest. The game combines real-time, third-person mounted and foot combat with strategic army management, allowing players to recruit troops, siege castles, serve lords, or claim territory for themselves. Warband expands on the original Mount & Blade with improved graphics, multiplayer battles, political systems, and the ability to establish and rule a kingdom. Its sandbox structure and large-scale battles made it a highly influential cult classic in the RPG genre.

title: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors
description: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors (often abbreviated 999) is a visual novel adventure game that blends escape-room puzzles with a suspenseful branching narrative. Players control Junpei, who awakens trapped aboard a sinking ship-like facility with eight other strangers, each forced to participate in the deadly Nonary Game. To survive, they must solve escape-room challenges, form alliances, and make difficult choices that affect the story’s flow. The game is known for its intricate plot, multiple endings, psychological horror elements, and clever use of the Nintendo DS’s dual screens and touch controls. It is the first entry in the Zero Escape series and helped establish the franchise’s reputation for elaborate time-loop mysteries and philosophical themes.

title: Portal: Still Alive
description: Portal: Still Alive is an expanded version of Valve’s award-winning first-person puzzle game Portal, released exclusively for Xbox Live Arcade. It includes the original Portal campaign plus 14 additional bonus challenge levels based on content cut from the original game. Players use the Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device to create linked portals, solving physics-based puzzles, navigating environmental hazards, and escaping the mysterious Aperture Science Enrichment Center. The game is known for its dark humor, atmospheric storytelling, and the iconic antagonistic AI GLaDOS.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3
description: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 is a 3D arena fighting game based on the Dragon Ball Z anime and manga series. It features a large roster of characters from Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball GT, and movie-original content, with fast-paced aerial combat, signature special moves, and destructible battle environments. The game includes multiple modes such as Story, World Tournament, and Dragon History, and is known for refining the gameplay of its predecessor with improved controls, added stages, and expanded character transformations. It became one of the most acclaimed Dragon Ball fighting games for its extensive content and faithful presentation of the series.

title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story
description: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story is a comedic action RPG in which Mario and Luigi are accidentally inhaled into Bowser's body and must work from the inside to help stop a crisis threatening the Mushroom Kingdom. Players switch between controlling the brothers’ inside-the-body exploration and Bowser’s adventures across the overworld, using timed turn-based battles, puzzles, and character-specific abilities. The game is known for its humor, inventive dual-scenario structure, and boss fights that make use of the Nintendo DS touchscreen and microphone.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars
description: Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars is a turn-based strategy game in which players build towns, recruit armies, gather resources, and explore a fantasy world map while commanding heroes in tactical battles. Set in the aftermath of a royal succession crisis, the game lets players choose between rival factions and vie for control of the kingdom through conquest, diplomacy, and strategic expansion. It expanded on the original with improved graphics, new creatures, more spells, and deeper campaign play, becoming one of the best-known entries in the series.

title: Heart of Darkness
description: Heart of Darkness is a cinematic 2D platform adventure game in which players control Andy, a young boy who ventures through dangerous, surreal worlds to rescue his dog, Whisky, from a shadowy force known as the Darkness. The game is known for its hand-drawn animation, atmospheric visuals, and puzzle-focused gameplay mixed with light action and exploration. Players must navigate hostile environments, avoid deadly traps, and use a variety of tools and abilities to overcome enemies and obstacles across an eerie fantasy setting.

title: Paper Mario
description: Paper Mario is a turn-based role-playing game set in the Mario universe, featuring a charming papercraft visual style. Players control Mario as he journeys across the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue Princess Peach and recover the seven Star Spirits after Bowser steals the Star Rod and takes over Star Haven. The game blends traditional RPG combat with timing-based action commands, exploration, puzzle solving, and light platforming elements. Its accessible mechanics, humorous writing, and memorable partners helped establish Paper Mario as a standout entry in the Mario franchise and a foundational title for the series.

title: Diablo II
description: Diablo II is an action role-playing game set in a dark fantasy world where players choose one of five character classes and battle through randomized dungeons, wilderness areas, and towns to stop the demonic Wanderer and the Prime Evils. The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, loot hunting, character customization through skill trees, and replayability across four acts. Its expansion, Lord of Destruction, added two new classes, new items, and an additional act, further expanding the game's depth and longevity.

title: Conker's Bad Fur Day
description: Conker's Bad Fur Day is a third-person action-platformer developed and published by Rare for the Nintendo 64. It follows Conker, a foul-mouthed red squirrel who stumbles through a bizarre, heavily parodied world after a night of drinking and partying leaves him trying to get home. The game is known for its adult humor, cinematic presentation, varied gameplay, and deliberate subversion of family-friendly platform game conventions. Players progress through a series of levels that mix platforming, shooting, puzzle-solving, and set-piece challenges, often featuring references to movies, television, and other games. Initially conceived as a more traditional title, it was redesigned into a mature comedy after development shifted direction late in production. Despite limited commercial success at launch, it became a cult classic and is widely remembered as one of the Nintendo 64's most distinctive games.

title: Dungeon Keeper 2
description: Dungeon Keeper 2 is a real-time strategy game that puts you in the role of a dungeon overlord. Instead of commanding noble heroes, you build and manage a subterranean lair, dig out rooms, train monstrous minions, and defend your dungeon from invading forces. The game combines strategy, resource management, trap placement, and direct possession of creatures for hands-on combat. It features a darkly humorous tone, stylized fantasy presentation, and a campaign focused on conquering enemy realms while protecting your own.

title: Age of Wonders
description: Age of Wonders is a turn-based strategy game that blends empire building, tactical combat, and fantasy role-playing elements. Players lead one of several races and hero units across a magical world, managing cities, researching spells, and expanding territory while engaging in grid-based battles. The game is known for its deep strategic systems, rich fantasy setting, and the ability to conquer or diplomatically influence rival factions.

title: Age of Mythology
description: Age of Mythology is a real-time strategy game set in a mythological version of the ancient world. Players choose from one of several civilizations inspired by Greek, Egyptian, and Norse cultures, build cities, gather resources, train armies, and invoke gods and mythological creatures to gain strategic advantages. The game combines classic RTS mechanics with divine powers, hero units, and fantastical units such as minotaurs, cyclopes, and mummies. Its campaign follows the hero Arkantos as he journeys across legendary lands and battles both mortal enemies and mythic threats. Known for its strong single-player story, varied factions, and competitive multiplayer, Age of Mythology became a celebrated spin-off of the Age of Empires series.

title: Metroid Fusion
description: Metroid Fusion is a side-scrolling action-adventure game in which Samus Aran investigates a dangerous parasite outbreak on the research station SR388 after a mission gone wrong. Infected by the X parasite and saved by a Metroid vaccine, Samus must navigate the station, fight mutated creatures, and evade the hostile SA-X, a powerful doppelganger created from her own DNA. The game features exploration, ability-based progression, atmospheric storytelling, and a more guided structure than earlier Metroid titles.

title: Might and Magic VI: The Mandate of Heaven
description: Might and Magic VI: The Mandate of Heaven is a first-person party-based role-playing game set in the fantasy world of Enroth. Players create and guide a party of four adventurers, exploring a large open world, completing quests, battling monsters in real time, and developing their characters through classes, skills, and spells. The game blends dungeon crawling, city exploration, and outdoor travel with a strong emphasis on freedom and non-linear progression. It is known for its expansive world, classic RPG systems, and connection to the broader Might and Magic series, serving as a direct sequel to Might and Magic V.

title: Master of Orion II: Battle at Antares
description: Master of Orion II: Battle at Antares is a classic 4X strategy game set in a science-fiction galaxy where players lead one of many alien civilizations to explore star systems, colonize planets, research technologies, conduct diplomacy, and wage interstellar war. As the sequel to Master of Orion, it expands the original formula with deeper empire management, custom species creation, richer diplomacy, espionage, and tactical ship combat. Players can pursue victory through conquest, population growth, technological superiority, or the Galactic Council. Widely regarded as one of the greatest strategy games ever made, it is known for its depth, replayability, and memorable alien races.

title: Vagrant Story
description: Vagrant Story is an action role-playing game set in the dark fantasy world of Ivalice. Players control Ashley Riot, an elite Riskbreaker investigating a cult conspiracy in the ruined city of Leá Monde. The game is known for its weapon customization, real-time combat with tactical targeting, and deep crafting and affinity systems. It features a mature storyline, atmospheric presentation, and distinctive art direction directed by Yasumi Matsuno and produced by Square for the original PlayStation.

title: Dungeon Keeper
description: Dungeon Keeper is a real-time strategy game with a darkly comic twist, originally released for PC. Players take on the role of an evil overlord building and defending an underground dungeon against invading heroes and rival keepers. Rather than commanding armies in a traditional battlefield, the player digs out rooms, places traps, manages gold and resources, and attracts and controls a variety of demonic creatures, each with distinct behaviors and needs. The game is known for its indirect control system, where creatures act semi-autonomously based on morale, hunger, and room conditions. Its blend of strategy, management, and humor made it highly influential and widely praised for its originality, atmosphere, and distinctive narrator.

title: Tekken 3
description: Tekken 3 is a landmark 3D fighting game from Namco and the third main entry in the Tekken series. It introduced a faster, more fluid combat system, improved sidestepping, and a greatly expanded roster that included new fighters such as Jin Kazama, Ling Xiaoyu, Hwoarang, and Eddy Gordo. The game also added deeper movement and combo possibilities, making matches feel more dynamic and responsive than its predecessors. Tekken 3 became one of the most successful arcade and PlayStation fighting games ever released, praised for its polished gameplay, character balance, and memorable presentation.

title: F-Zero GX
description: F-Zero GX is a high-speed futuristic racing game for the Nintendo GameCube, known for its blistering pace, challenging tracks, and precise handling. Players pilot anti-gravity racing craft through dangerous courses filled with sharp turns, jumps, and hazards while competing against a roster of rival racers. The game features a story mode, Grand Prix races, time attack challenges, and custom machine options. It is widely praised for its smooth performance, intense difficulty, and arcade-style presentation, and is considered one of the most acclaimed entries in the F-Zero series.

title: Resident Evil 2 (1998)
description: Resident Evil 2 is a survival horror game set in the zombie-infested Raccoon City, where players control Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield as they search for answers and try to escape the outbreak. The game features tense exploration, limited resources, puzzle solving, and combat against mutated creatures and viral monstrosities. Its dual-scenario structure lets players experience overlapping events from different perspectives, adding replay value and narrative depth. Widely praised for its atmosphere, pacing, and presentation, Resident Evil 2 became one of the most influential and acclaimed entries in the series.

title: Homeworld: Cataclysm
description: Homeworld: Cataclysm is a real-time strategy game set in the Homeworld universe, focused on 3D space combat and fleet management. Players command the Somtaaw mining clan as they uncover and battle a parasitic alien threat called the Beast, which spreads by corrupting ships and technologies. The game expands on the original Homeworld’s fully three-dimensional tactical gameplay, emphasizing resource gathering, ship progression, and adaptation as the infestation evolves. It is known for its atmosphere, storyline, and distinctive fusion of strategy and sci-fi survival themes.

title: Baldur's Gate
description: Baldur's Gate is a classic real-time with pause role-playing game set in the Dungeons & Dragons Forgotten Realms universe. Players create a custom hero and lead a party of adventurers across the Sword Coast, exploring towns, wilderness areas, and dangerous dungeons while uncovering a conspiracy tied to the scarcity of iron in the region. The game emphasizes party management, character progression, dialogue choices, and tactical combat based on Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition rules. It became highly influential for modern party-based RPGs and helped define BioWare as a major RPG developer.

title: Worms Armageddon
description: Worms Armageddon is a turn-based artillery strategy game in which teams of worms battle across 2D destructible landscapes using absurd weapons and gadgets. Players take turns moving, aiming, and firing while managing wind, terrain, and limited resources to outlast rival teams. The game is known for its deep tactical gameplay, humorous presentation, extensive customization, and a huge arsenal that ranges from bazookas and grenades to more outlandish attacks. Its multiplayer and challenge modes made it a long-lasting fan favorite and one of the best-known entries in the Worms series.

title: Outcast
description: Outcast is a third-person action-adventure game set in the alien world of Adelpha. Players control Cutter Slade, a U.S. Navy SEAL sent through a scientific portal to rescue Earth from catastrophe. Stranded on Adelpha, he must explore diverse regions, interact with native inhabitants, complete missions, and help unite the world’s tribes against a tyrannical ruler. The game is known for its open-ended structure, atmospheric orchestral soundtrack, and pioneering voxel-based graphics that gave its environments a distinctive look.

title: Thief II: The Metal Age
description: Thief II: The Metal Age is a stealth-focused first-person action game set in a dark steampunk world. Players again control Garrett, a master thief who relies on shadows, sound, and an arsenal of tools to infiltrate heavily guarded locations, avoid combat, and steal valuable objects. The game expands on the original Thief with larger levels, improved AI, and more emphasis on mission objectives tied to uncovering a conspiracy involving the mechanized Hammerites and the sinister Metal Age. Known for its atmospheric design and demanding stealth gameplay, it is widely regarded as one of the genre’s defining titles.

title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
description: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night is a 2D action-adventure game developed and published by Konami. It follows Alucard, the dhampir son of Dracula, as he explores the mysterious inverted castle after the events of Castlevania: Rondo of Blood. The game is renowned for its non-linear exploration, RPG elements, hidden secrets, and atmospheric gothic art and music. Widely considered one of the most influential games ever made, it helped define the Metroidvania genre and became a critical and fan favorite for its deep gameplay and replay value.

title: Myth II: Soulblighter
description: Myth II: Soulblighter is a real-time tactics game and the sequel to Bungie’s Myth: The Fallen Lords. Set in a dark fantasy world, it focuses on squad-based combat rather than base building or resource gathering. Players command a small army of units across mission-driven campaigns, using positioning, terrain, and line-of-sight to defeat enemy forces. The game continues the struggle against the undead warlord Soulblighter, with a story told through atmospheric missions and lore-rich cutscenes. It is praised for its tactical depth, challenging scenarios, and strong multiplayer support, and it became known for its refined gameplay and modding community.

title: Super Mario World: Super Mario Advance 2
description: Super Mario World: Super Mario Advance 2 is a Game Boy Advance remake of the classic Super Nintendo platformer Super Mario World. It follows Mario and Luigi as they travel through Dinosaur Land to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser and his Koopalings. The game features side-scrolling platforming across large interconnected worlds, secret exits, and numerous hidden paths. This version adds updated graphics and sound for the GBA, support for Luigi as a playable character with distinct physics, and the inclusion of Mario Bros. as a bonus game. It is known for preserving the original level design and tight controls while adapting the experience for portable play.

title: GoldenEye 007
description: GoldenEye 007 is a first-person shooter based on the 1995 James Bond film GoldenEye. Players control James Bond through a series of stealth-focused and action-packed missions across varied locations, using a mix of firearms, gadgets, and mission objectives. Developed by Rare, the game became highly influential for its objective-based single-player campaign and groundbreaking split-screen multiplayer on the Nintendo 64. Its combination of spy-themed levels, varied mission design, and accessible controls helped define console shooters and made it one of the most acclaimed games of its era.

title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past / Four Swords
description: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past / Four Swords is a Game Boy Advance re-release that bundles the classic 1991 SNES adventure A Link to the Past with Four Swords, the series' first multiplayer-focused Zelda game. A Link to the Past follows Link as he explores Hyrule and the Dark World to rescue Princess Zelda and defeat Ganon, featuring top-down exploration, dungeon crawling, puzzle solving, and iconic items like the Master Sword and Hookshot. Four Swords adds competitive and cooperative multiplayer for up to four players, requiring teamwork to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and collect Force Gems while each Link can split into multiple copies. This compilation introduced both games to the handheld audience and remains notable for combining one of the most acclaimed Zelda adventures with a unique multiplayer experiment.

title: Gran Turismo 2
description: Gran Turismo 2 is a racing simulation game focused on realism, car collection, and competitive driving. It features a much larger roster of vehicles and tracks than its predecessor, with a wide range of manufacturers, tuning options, licenses, and race events. Players can progress through Arcade and Gran Turismo modes, earning money to buy, upgrade, and customize cars across various motorsport disciplines. Known for its attention to detail and accessible-yet-deep driving mechanics, Gran Turismo 2 helped define console racing games and became one of the best-selling titles on the original PlayStation.

title: Blood
description: Blood is a dark, horror-themed first-person shooter released for PC in 1997. Set in a grotesque, supernatural world inspired by pulp horror and occult fiction, it follows undead gunslinger Caleb as he rises from the grave seeking revenge against the cult leader Tchernobog and his followers. The game is known for its intense combat, extensive arsenal of weird and brutal weapons, and its heavily atmospheric, tongue-in-cheek tone. Players battle through labyrinthine levels filled with secret areas, traps, and a variety of grotesque enemies, including cultists, zombies, and other monsters. Blood became notable for its gore effects, dark humor, and challenging level design, and it has remained a cult classic among fans of '90s shooters.

title: Beyond Good & Evil
description: Beyond Good & Evil is an action-adventure game set on the planet Hillys, where an investigative reporter named Jade uncovers a vast alien conspiracy while protecting a resistance movement. Players explore a mix of open environments, solve puzzles, engage in stealth and combat, and use Jade’s camera to document evidence for a rebellion against the DomZ and the corrupt military regime. The game is known for its distinctive art style, memorable characters, orchestral soundtrack by Christophe Héral, and a story that blends sci-fi, humor, and social commentary. Although it was not a major commercial success at launch, it later earned a strong cult following and is widely regarded as a classic of the genre.

title: Original War
description: Original War is a real-time strategy game set in an alternate-history Cold War scenario where players command military units, resources, and specialists across a prehistoric battlefield. Instead of building bases in the usual way, the game emphasizes capturing and controlling key locations, managing human characters with distinct skills, and using a unique time-travel premise to influence events. Players can recruit engineers, scientists, and combat units, research technologies, and balance strategic planning with character survival. Its story-driven campaigns and branching factions create a strong focus on tactical decision-making and narrative consequences.

title: Disciples II: Dark Prophecy
description: Disciples II: Dark Prophecy is a dark fantasy turn-based strategy game with role-playing elements and tactical combat. Players lead one of several factions in a war for control of a grim, monster-haunted world, building towns, recruiting armies, and developing heroes with unique skills and spellcasting abilities. The game is known for its gothic atmosphere, detailed artwork, and challenging strategic battles that emphasize positioning, unit upgrades, and careful resource management. As the first campaign in Disciples II, Dark Prophecy introduces the core story and mechanics of the series, combining empire management on the adventure map with intense, compact combat encounters.

title: Unreal
description: Unreal is a first-person shooter developed by Epic MegaGames and Digital Extremes, originally released in 1998. Set on the alien planet Na Pali, the game follows a prisoner who escapes a crashed transport and must fight through a hostile world dominated by the brutal Skaarj. Known for its advanced graphics for the time, atmospheric environments, and technical showcase use of the Unreal Engine, the game combined fast-paced combat with exploration and a strong science-fiction setting. Unreal helped establish the foundation for one of gaming’s most influential engine technologies and became the start of the long-running Unreal franchise.

title: Golden Sun: The Lost Age
description: Golden Sun: The Lost Age is a turn-based fantasy role-playing game and the sequel to Golden Sun. Players follow a new party of protagonists, including Felix and Jenna, as they continue the story from the first game and explore the world of Weyard. The game features strategic turn-based battles, elemental Psynergy magic, character classes influenced by collectible Djinn, and elaborate puzzle-solving in dungeons using magical abilities. It is known for its deep combat system, exploration, and the ability to transfer save data from the previous game to affect story details and character progression.

title: Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria
description: Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria is a Japanese role-playing game set in a Norse-inspired world, serving as a prequel to Valkyrie Profile. The story follows Silmeria, a valkyrie imprisoned in the body of Princess Alicia, as they investigate a looming conflict involving the gods, humans, and the fate of the world. Players explore side-scrolling environments, solve puzzles, and engage in strategic real-time combat that emphasizes positioning, timing, and chaining attacks among party members. The game features a distinctive “C.V.S.” battle system, dungeons filled with platforming challenges, and a deep equipment and skill customization system.

title: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature
description: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature is a farming life simulation RPG for the PlayStation, set in the rustic village of Mineral Town.
