Players inherit a neglected farm and work to restore it by planting crops, raising livestock, fishing, mining, foraging, and building relationships with the local townspeople. The game emphasizes daily routine, long-term planning, and community life, with changing seasons, festivals, marriage options, and the eventual goal of successfully reviving the farm. It is one of the most beloved entries in the Harvest Moon series and is especially known for its charming atmosphere, deep social systems, and relaxing gameplay.

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Nocturne
description: Shin Megami Tensei: Nocturne is a dungeon-crawling role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic Tokyo transformed by the mystical event known as the Conception. Players control a silent protagonist who becomes a demi-fiend and must navigate a hostile world shaped by competing philosophies and demonic forces. The game features turn-based combat, demon recruitment and fusion, and a dark, challenging atmosphere centered on choice, alignment, and survival. It originally released in Japan for PlayStation 2 and later received enhanced international versions, including the expanded Maniacs edition and the HD Remaster for modern platforms.

title: Golden Sun
platforms: ['Game Boy Advance', 'Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack']
description: Golden Sun is a classic turn-based fantasy RPG for the Game Boy Advance. Set in the world of Weyard, it follows a group of young Adepts who must stop the power of Alchemy from being unleashed by the antagonists Saturos and Menardi. The game is known for its blend of traditional party-based combat, exploration, and puzzle solving using magical powers called Psynergy. Players collect Djinn, elemental spirits that can be set to characters to alter their stats, abilities, and summons. Golden Sun was praised for its detailed sprite graphics, soundtrack, and clever dungeon design, and it became one of the most acclaimed role-playing games on the GBA.

title: Age of Empires II: Gold Edition
description: Age of Empires II: Gold Edition is a real-time strategy compilation for PC that bundles Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings with its expansion, The Conquerors. Players build civilizations from the Middle Ages, gather resources, advance through ages, and wage war using infantry, cavalry, archers, siege weapons, and naval forces. The Gold Edition adds new campaigns, civilizations, units, and gameplay refinements from The Conquerors expansion, making it a definitive early version of the classic strategy experience.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2
description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 is a real-time strategy game set in an alternate-history Cold War where the Soviet Union and the Allied nations wage global war. Players gather resources, build bases, produce units, and command armies across fast-paced single-player campaigns and skirmish battles. The game is known for its distinct faction design, memorable live-action cutscenes, and over-the-top unit abilities such as psychic powers, giant war machines, and naval assaults. It also introduced the expansion Yuri's Revenge, which added a third faction and new campaign content. Red Alert 2 is widely regarded as one of the most popular and influential RTS titles of its era.

title: Stronghold
description: Stronghold is a real-time strategy and castle simulation game set in medieval England. Players build and manage a fortress, balance food, tax, housing, and popularity, and command armies in siege warfare against rival lords. The game combines city-building and economic management with tactical combat, emphasizing defense, supply chains, and fortification design. It became known for its distinctive focus on castle construction and historical medieval atmosphere.

title: The Ultimate DOOM
description: The Ultimate DOOM is an expanded edition of the original DOOM, featuring all three episodes from the 1993 game plus a brand-new fourth episode, Thy Flesh Consumed. Players battle through demonic hordes across fast-paced first-person shooter levels while collecting weapons, health, and ammo, using classic guns like the shotgun, chaingun, rocket launcher, and the powerful BFG 9000. The game is known for its intense action, maze-like level design, multiplayer deathmatch support, and defining influence on the FPS genre. It was released as a retail update to the original DOOM and remains one of the most iconic and influential shooters ever made.

title: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
description: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne is a cinematic third-person shooter following ex-cop Max Payne as he becomes entangled in a dark noir mystery in New York City. Blending bullet-time gunplay, dramatic storytelling, and comic-panel cutscenes, the game continues Max’s story as he reunites with Mona Sax while uncovering a conspiracy involving corruption, betrayal, and revenge. The game is known for its tight shooting mechanics, atmospheric presentation, and emotionally driven narrative.

title: Stronghold: Crusader
description: Stronghold: Crusader is a real-time strategy and castle-simulation game set during the medieval Crusades. Players build and manage desert fortresses, gather resources, train armies, and defend against or attack enemy strongholds. It expands on the original Stronghold by focusing on Middle Eastern warfare, introducing new units, siege equipment, and AI lords with distinct tactics. The game includes a large single-player campaign, historical skirmish missions, and the popular Crusader Trail challenge mode, emphasizing resource management, fortification design, and large-scale sieges.

title: Quake II
description: Quake II is a first-person shooter set in a dark sci-fi war against the Strogg, a hostile cybernetic alien race. Unlike its predecessor, it features a more cohesive single-player campaign with mission-based objectives, as well as fast-paced multiplayer deathmatch gameplay. Players battle through industrial bases, military installations, and alien environments using a arsenal of weapons such as the blaster, shotgun, railgun, and hyperblaster. Known for its atmospheric level design, strong performance, and influential multiplayer, Quake II became one of the defining shooters of the late 1990s and helped establish id Software’s reputation for technical and gameplay innovation.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
description: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy is a 3D platforming adventure set on the colorful island world of Misty Island, Geyser Rock, and other interconnected locations. Players control Jak as he and his wisecracking companion Daxter explore environments, collect Precursor Orbs and Power Cells, and uncover the secrets of a vanished ancient civilization called the Precursors. The game blends exploration, platforming, light combat, and puzzle-solving, with a focus on open-ended progression through multiple regions. It is the first entry in the Jak and Daxter series and is known for its bright art style, smooth controls, and seamless world design.

title: Space Rangers
description: Space Rangers is a hybrid open-world space adventure that blends RPG, strategy, trading, combat, and text-based quest elements. Set in a dynamic galaxy overrun by hostile robots known as the Dominators, players choose among multiple careers such as trader, pirate, military pilot, or bounty hunter. The game features free-form exploration, turn-based tactical ground missions, real-time space combat, and a living economy shaped by faction wars and changing events. Its nonlinear structure and high replayability made it a cult classic among PC strategy-RPG fans.

title: Firewall Zero Hour
description: Firewall Zero Hour is a tactical first-person shooter designed for PlayStation VR. Two teams of mercenaries face off in objective-based multiplayer matches, where one team attacks to hack a laptop while the other defends and tries to eliminate the opposition. The game emphasizes communication, teamwork, and careful planning, with VR immersion enhancing the tension of close-quarters combat. Players can choose from a roster of contractors, each with unique abilities and loadouts, and progress by completing contracts to unlock new gear and customization options. Built around strategic positioning and coordinated assaults rather than fast arcade shooting, Firewall Zero Hour became one of the most notable competitive VR shooters on PS4.

title: Darkarta: A Broken Heart's Quest
description: Darkarta: A Broken Heart's Quest is a hidden-object adventure game set in a mystical world inspired by ancient myths and legends. Players follow Mary as she searches for her missing daughter, uncovering the dark secrets of the island of Darkarta and confronting a powerful evil force. The game combines story-driven exploration, puzzle solving, hidden-object scenes, and mini-games as the player travels through richly illustrated locations and pieces together the truth behind the disappearance. It is known for its atmospheric presentation, emotional storyline, and classic casual adventure gameplay.

title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
description: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is the second entry in Square Enix’s remake project of Final Fantasy VII. It follows Cloud Strife and his allies as they leave Midgar and journey across the wider world in pursuit of Sephiroth. The game expands the original story with new locations, side quests, combat mechanics, and character interactions while blending real-time action with strategic command-based abilities. It features a large open-world structure, a party system with multiple playable characters, and a cinematic presentation that continues the reimagined narrative of the classic RPG.

title: The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles
description: The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles is a compilation of two legal adventure games, The Great Ace Attorney: Adventures and The Great Ace Attorney 2: Resolve. Set in late 19th-century Japan and Victorian-era London, it follows Ryunosuke Naruhodo, an ancestor of Phoenix Wright, as he studies law, teams up with detective Herlock Sholmes, and defends clients in courtroom battles filled with investigation, puzzles, and dramatic twists. The collection features updated visuals, English localization, and quality-of-life improvements.

title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
description: Kirby and the Forgotten Land is a 3D platform-adventure game starring Kirby, who explores a mysterious post-apocalyptic world filled with abandoned cities, ruins, and strange wildlife. Players can inhale enemies, copy their abilities, and use new forms of movement and combat to navigate open-ended stages. The game introduces the Mouthful Mode mechanic, which lets Kirby wrap around large objects such as cars, vending machines, and traffic cones to solve puzzles and access hidden areas. It also includes co-op play with Bandana Waddle Dee and a variety of boss battles, collectibles, and upgradeable copy abilities. Combining classic Kirby charm with modern 3D level design, the game emphasizes exploration, light combat, and creative platforming.

title: Hi-Fi Rush
description: Hi-Fi Rush is a rhythm-action game where every move, attack, and combo syncs to the beat of the music. Players control Chai, an aspiring rockstar with a faulty robotic arm, who gains the power to fight in time with the soundtrack after a corporate experiment fuses music into his world. Set in a colorful, cel-shaded sci-fi facility, the game blends fast-paced combat, platforming, and stylish boss battles with a strong emphasis on timing and musical flow. Its mix of accessible action and rhythm-based mechanics, along with energetic presentation and humor, made it a standout release.

title: Pizza Tower
description: Pizza Tower is a fast-paced 2D action platformer inspired by classic Wario Land games. Players control Peppino Spaghetti, a highly anxious but surprisingly capable pizza chef, as he races through surreal, hand-drawn levels inside a bizarre tower to recover his restaurant’s reputation and stop the tower’s plans. The game emphasizes momentum, exploration, combo-driven scoring, and frantic movement, rewarding players for smashing through enemies, chaining abilities, and clearing stages quickly. Its cartoon-like animation, expressive character work, and energetic soundtrack give it a distinct personality, while secrets, ranked stage endings, and time attacks add replay value for players seeking high scores and mastery.

title: Metroid Prime Remastered
description: Metroid Prime Remastered is an enhanced version of the original 2002 first-person adventure game Metroid Prime. Players control Samus Aran as she explores the alien planet Tallon IV, scanning environments, battling hostile creatures, uncovering lore, and gradually gaining new abilities to access previously unreachable areas. The remaster features updated visuals, improved lighting, refined controls with modern dual-stick support, and quality-of-life updates while preserving the original atmosphere, exploration-driven gameplay, and puzzle-solving design that made the game a classic.

title: Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS / Wii U
description: Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS / Wii U is a crossover fighting game that brings together characters, stages, and music from across Nintendo’s history and several third-party series. Players battle in fast-paced arena fights using attacks, special moves, items, and stage hazards, with the goal of knocking opponents off the stage rather than reducing a health bar. The game features a large roster including Mario, Link, Pikachu, Kirby, and newcomers such as Mega Man, Villager, and the Wii Fit Trainer. The 3DS version includes exclusive stages and modes, while the Wii U version offers enhanced visuals, a larger stage selection, and multiplayer options for up to eight players. Both versions support local and online play, trophies/collectibles, and extensive customization of fighters and equipment.

title: To the Moon
description: To the Moon is a story-driven adventure game about two doctors who use a technology to enter a dying man's memories and alter his past so he can fulfill his final wish: to go to the moon. The game focuses on exploration, dialogue, and narrative choices rather than combat or puzzles, and is known for its emotional storytelling, memorable music, and pixel-art presentation.

title: Red Dead Redemption: Game of the Year Edition
description: Red Dead Redemption: Game of the Year Edition is the definitive release of Rockstar’s open-world Western action game, bundling the original Red Dead Redemption with its major downloadable content. Set in the dying days of the American frontier, the game follows former outlaw John Marston as he is forced by federal agents to hunt down members of his old gang in exchange for his family’s safety. Players explore a vast world on horseback, engage in gunfights, hunt wildlife, take on side activities, and experience a story driven by themes of loyalty, violence, and the end of the Old West. The Game of the Year Edition includes the single-player Undead Nightmare expansion and additional bonus content, offering more missions, weapons, challenges, and multiplayer content in one package.

title: God of War: Origins Collection
description: God of War: Origins Collection is a PlayStation 3 compilation of the two PlayStation Portable God of War titles, God of War: Chains of Olympus and God of War: Ghost of Sparta. The collection features remastered high-definition visuals, anti-aliasing, trophy support, and improved performance for home consoles. Players follow Kratos through prequel stories set before the original God of War, battling mythological creatures, solving environmental puzzles, and using the franchise’s signature combo-based combat and brutal finishers. Developed by Ready at Dawn and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, the collection brought the PSP entries to a wider audience with enhanced presentation and a polished console experience.

title: Pikmin 3
description: Pikmin 3 is a real-time strategy adventure game in which players control three explorers stranded on the planet PNF-404 and command small plant-like creatures called Pikmin to solve puzzles, gather fruit, and battle hostile wildlife. Each Pikmin type has unique abilities, such as red Pikmin resisting fire, yellow Pikmin handling electricity, and blue Pikmin surviving in water, which players must use strategically to navigate environments and complete objectives. The game emphasizes exploration, multitasking, and resource management as players split tasks between characters and direct squads of Pikmin to overcome environmental hazards. Originally released for the Wii U, it received an enhanced Nintendo Switch version, Pikmin 3 Deluxe, with additional features and content.

title: P.T.
description: P.T. (short for "playable teaser") is a first-person psychological horror demo released for the PlayStation 4. Designed as a mysterious teaser for the cancelled Silent Hills project, it places the player in a looping, dimly lit suburban hallway filled with unsettling supernatural events, cryptic puzzles, and escalating tension. The experience became famous for its atmospheric terror, clever design, and hidden clues, as well as for the collaboration between Hideo Kojima and filmmaker Guillermo del Toro. Although the full game was never completed, P.T. has remained highly influential and is widely regarded as one of the most memorable horror experiences in gaming.

title: Yakuza 0
description: Yakuza 0 is an action-adventure game and a prequel to the Yakuza series, set in the late 1980s during Japan's bubble era. Players follow two protagonists, Kazuma Kiryu and Goro Majima, as they become entangled in a violent struggle over a small but highly valuable plot of land known as the Empty Lot in Kamurocho. The game blends dramatic crime drama storytelling with brawler combat, side activities, karaoke, mini-games, and exploration of the vibrant city districts of Kamurocho and Sotenbori. It is widely praised for its writing, characters, and polished combat system.

title: Sonic 3 & Knuckles
description: Sonic 3 & Knuckles is a side-scrolling platformer that combines Sonic the Hedgehog 3 and Sonic & Knuckles into a single, seamless adventure using Sega’s lock-on technology. Players control Sonic and/or Knuckles as they race through large, colorful stages, battle Dr. Robotnik’s machines, and collect Chaos Emeralds. Each character has unique abilities: Sonic can use elemental shields and fast movement, while Knuckles can glide and climb walls to access alternate routes and hidden areas. The game is known for its expansive level design, multi-path stages, and polished physics, and it is widely regarded as one of the best entries in the Sonic series.

title: Super Mario 3D World
description: Super Mario 3D World is a 3D platforming adventure in which Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, and Toad travel through the Sprixie Kingdom to rescue the Sprixie Princesses from Bowser. The game blends traditional Mario-style platforming with cooperative multiplayer for up to four players, offering inventive level design, power-ups like the Super Bell, and character-specific abilities. Originally released for Wii U, it was later enhanced and re-released on Nintendo Switch as Super Mario 3D World + Bowser’s Fury, adding improved online play and the bonus open-world Bowser’s Fury mode.

title: The Wolf Among Us: Episode 1 - Faith
description: The first episode of The Wolf Among Us, based on Bill Willingham’s Fables comic series, introduces players to Bigby Wolf, the sheriff of Fabletown. Set in a dark, noir-style version of New York City, the game follows Bigby as he investigates a brutal murder that quickly spirals into a larger mystery involving the hidden lives of fairy-tale characters living among humans. Like other Telltale adventure games, it emphasizes story, dialogue choices, quick-time events, and branching decisions that affect how characters respond to Bigby throughout the series. Episode 1, Faith, establishes the game’s gritty tone, distinctive art style, and central cast while setting up the moral dilemmas and tension that drive the narrative forward.

title: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair
description: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair is a visual novel adventure game and the sequel to Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc. It follows a new group of elite students, the "Ultimate" students, who find themselves trapped on the tropical Jabberwock Island and forced into a deadly killing game by the mysterious Monokuma. Players investigate murders, gather clues, and participate in high-stakes class trials where contradictions are exposed through logic, reaction-based debates, and minigames. The story mixes suspense, dark comedy, and psychological twists, with multiple character-driven trials and an overarching mystery about the island and the participants' pasts.

title: RimWorld
description: RimWorld is a sci-fi colony simulation and survival game where players manage a group of crash-landed survivors on a hostile alien planet. Designed around emergent storytelling, the game uses a powerful AI storyteller system to generate events, threats, and opportunities that shape each playthrough differently. Players build shelters, gather resources, research technologies, manage colonists' needs and relationships, and defend against raids, disease, weather, and environmental hazards. The game is known for its deep simulation, mod support, and unpredictable scenarios that can lead to dramatic, often humorous stories.

title: Muv-Luv Alternative
description: Muv-Luv Alternative is a Japanese visual novel and the direct sequel to Muv-Luv. It continues the story of Takeru Shirogane as he is thrust back into a devastating alternate-world conflict against the alien BETA. Blending military science fiction, drama, and romance, the game is known for its intense narrative, large-scale battles, and emotional character arcs. It is widely regarded as one of the most acclaimed visual novels ever made, and its influence helped shape the popularity of the genre beyond Japan.

title: Therian Saga
description: Therian Saga is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game set in a persistent fantasy world where players focus on exploration, crafting, trading, and long-term character development rather than traditional combat-heavy progression. Players build their reputation through professions, resource gathering, and economic activity, working cooperatively or competitively in a sandbox-style environment. The game features a classless progression system, a vast world to explore, and a player-driven economy centered on crafting and market exchange. Its design emphasizes strategic planning, specialization, and social interaction, with many activities unfolding over extended real-time periods.

title: Portal: Still Alive
description: Portal: Still Alive is an expanded version of Valve’s award-winning puzzle-adventure game Portal, released for Xbox 360 via Xbox Live Arcade. It includes the full original Portal campaign set in Aperture Science, where players use the handheld portal device to solve physics-based puzzles, navigate hazardous test chambers, and outsmart the AI GLaDOS. Still Alive adds 14 bonus challenge maps inspired by earlier PC map pack content, increasing replay value and emphasizing precision, speed, and creative portal use. The game is known for its dark humor, minimalist storytelling, iconic level design, and memorable antagonist. While it retains the core gameplay of Portal, this edition is specifically notable for bringing the experience to consoles with the bonus content packaged in one release.

title: Batman: Arkham City
description: Batman: Arkham City is an action-adventure game set in a massive open-world prison district in Gotham City. Players take control of Batman as he investigates a sinister plot involving Arkham City, a walled-off area where Gotham’s most dangerous criminals are confined. The game blends stealth, free-flow combat, detective work, and gadget-based exploration, with Batman facing iconic villains such as the Joker, Two-Face, Penguin, and Hugo Strange. It is widely praised for its atmosphere, story, combat system, and faithful portrayal of the Dark Knight.

title: Space Rangers
description: Space Rangers is a genre-blending sci-fi RPG with strategy, trading, and open-ended exploration set in a vast galaxy overrun by hostile alien forces. Players take on the role of a member of the Coalition, choosing their own path as a merchant, bounty hunter, pirate, explorer, or military officer. The game mixes turn-based space combat, text adventures, planetary missions, and dynamic economic simulation, allowing for highly varied playthroughs. Its freeform structure, humor, and emergent gameplay helped it become a cult classic among PC strategy and RPG fans.

title: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes
description: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes is a first-person action-adventure game and the sequel to Metroid Prime. Players control Samus Aran as she explores the planet Aether, which has been split into the bright Light World and the dangerous Dark World. Using the series’ signature mix of exploration, combat, puzzle-solving, and ability-based progression, Samus must uncover the mystery behind the planet’s corruption while battling hostile creatures and the Ing Empire. The game is known for its atmospheric environments, challenging combat, and the Dark Aether mechanic, which continuously damages Samus unless she finds safe zones or upgrades. It expands on the Prime formula with new weapons, beams, visors, and multiplayer deathmatch mode.

title: Space Rangers 2: Reboot
description: Space Rangers 2: Reboot is a hybrid sci-fi RPG/strategy game set in a living galaxy threatened by the hostile Dominators. Players take on the role of a space ranger, freely choosing how to progress through trading, combat, exploration, piracy, diplomacy, or bounty hunting. The game combines real-time tactical space battles, text adventures, planet-side missions, and turn-based strategy elements in a dynamic open universe where factions, economies, and events evolve independently of the player. It is known for its humorous writing, large amount of content, and high replayability. 'Reboot' refers to the enhanced, remastered edition released with improved compatibility, updated content, and refinements over the original Space Rangers 2.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando
description: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando is a third-person action-platformer and the second main entry in the Ratchet & Clank series. Players control Ratchet, with his robotic companion Clank, as they travel across multiple planets, battle enemies with an inventive arsenal of upgradeable weapons and gadgets, and complete missions involving combat, platforming, puzzles, and light exploration. The game expands on the original with deeper weapon progression, arena challenges, hoverboard races, and RPG-like customization elements. Set in a colorful sci-fi universe, it follows Ratchet’s adventure after he is hired by the Megacorp corporation, only to become involved in a larger conspiracy. The game is known for its fast-paced combat, humor, polished presentation, and extensive use of unique weapons.

title: Knights of Honor
description: Knights of Honor is a real-time strategy game with strong grand-strategy elements, set in medieval Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. Players take control of one of many kingdoms and guide it through diplomacy, warfare, economics, religion, and dynastic politics. The game blends army management with kingdom-level decisions, allowing players to appoint knights as marshals, spymasters, priests, merchants, and diplomats to influence their realm. Battles are fought in real time, while territorial control and expansion are managed on a strategic map. Its focus on accessible empire-building and historical flavor made it a distinctive entry in the genre.

title: God Hand
description: God Hand is a third-person beat 'em up and action game developed by Clover Studio and published by Capcom for the PlayStation 2. Players control Gene, a martial artist who acquires the legendary God Hand, a powerful divine arm, and must battle through a bizarre, over-the-top world filled with gangs, demons, and eccentric bosses. The game is known for its humorous tone, exaggerated difficulty, customizable combat moves, and dynamic enemy AI that adapts to the player's skill level. Its combat system lets players chain punches, kicks, and special techniques into stylish combos while managing a unique risk-reward mechanic centered on Gene's special abilities. God Hand became a cult classic for its challenging gameplay, distinctive art style, and self-aware comedy.

title: Space Rangers 2: Rise of the Dominators
description: Space Rangers 2: Rise of the Dominators is a genre-blending sci-fi RPG set in a living galaxy filled with trade, exploration, combat, and emergent events. Players take on the role of a Space Ranger, choosing from multiple career paths such as trader, pirate, bounty hunter, or warrior while battling the Dominators, a machine race threatening the galaxy. The game combines turn-based planetary exploration, real-time space combat, text adventures, strategy-style missions, and open-ended sandbox progression. Its strong emphasis on freedom, randomized events, and quirky humor made it a cult favorite among PC players.

title: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves
description: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves is a stealth-action platformer and the third entry in the Sly Cooper series. The game follows master thief Sly Cooper, his partner Bentley, and brawler Murray as they assemble a team to break into the heavily fortified Cooper Vault. To succeed, they travel the world recruiting specialists and pulling off elaborate heists across varied locations. Gameplay mixes stealth, platforming, combat, and vehicle-based missions, with each character offering different abilities and play styles. The game also expands on the series with cooperative-style team planning, new playable characters, and a larger focus on cinematic presentation and mission variety. It is known for its stylish cel-shaded visuals, humor, and colorful cast of characters.

title: Bully
description: Bully is an open-world action-adventure game set at the fictional Bullworth Academy, a troubled boarding school in New England. Players control Jimmy Hopkins, a rebellious teen navigating school life, social cliques, pranks, classes, and rivalries while trying to stop bullying and rise through the school's hierarchy. The game mixes exploration, melee combat, stealth, mini-games, and side missions with a satirical story about adolescence and authority. Originally released on PlayStation 2, it later appeared in an enhanced Scholarship Edition for other platforms.

title: The World Ends with You
description: The World Ends with You is an action role-playing game set in modern-day Shibuya, Tokyo. Players follow Neku Sakuraba, a reclusive teenager forced into the mysterious Reapers' Game, a seven-day survival challenge where he teams up with different partners to battle supernatural enemies called Noise. The game is known for its distinctive art style, urban fashion-inspired aesthetic, and fast-paced, touch-based combat that originally used both Nintendo DS screens simultaneously. It blends exploration, character-driven storytelling, and a soundtrack that mixes pop, rock, and electronic music. The story explores themes of isolation, connection, and personal growth as Neku uncovers the truth behind the game and the people around him.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines
description: A cult-classic action RPG set in White Wolf’s World of Darkness, Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines lets players create a vampire and navigate a modern-night Los Angeles filled with politics, horror, and supernatural intrigue. The game features multiple clans, each with distinct abilities and playstyles, and emphasizes dialogue, stealth, combat, and choice-driven quests. Players balance feeding on humans, managing their Masquerade status, and aligning with powerful factions while uncovering a dark conspiracy. Despite a troubled launch, it became widely praised for its writing, atmosphere, and role-playing depth.

title: WWE SmackDown! Here Comes the Pain
description: WWE SmackDown! Here Comes the Pain is a professional wrestling video game featuring WWE Superstars from the early 2000s era. It offers a large roster, fast-paced arcade-style wrestling, and a variety of match types including singles, tag team, hardcore, cage, and elimination matches. The game is especially known for its improved grappling system, backstage brawls, season mode, and deep customization options. Players can create wrestlers, compete for championships, and experience career progression in a full season mode with story elements and branching paths. Widely regarded as one of the best wrestling games of its generation, it is remembered for its polished gameplay, strong roster, and high replay value.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-Earth II - The Rise of the Witch-King
description: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-Earth II - The Rise of the Witch-king is an expansion to the real-time strategy game The Battle for Middle-earth II, set in J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle-earth. It adds a new Evil faction, Angmar, led by the Witch-king of Angmar, along with a new campaign focused on the rise and conquests of this dark realm in the North. The expansion introduces new units, heroes, maps, and multiplayer features, and expands the strategic depth of the base game with new abilities and faction-specific mechanics.

title: NieR: Automata - Game of the YoRHa Edition
description: NieR: Automata - Game of the YoRHa Edition is a complete edition of the acclaimed action RPG NieR: Automata, developed by PlatinumGames and produced by Square Enix. Set in a post-apocalyptic future where alien machines have driven humanity to the moon, players control YoRHa android combat units 2B, 9S, and A2 as they fight to reclaim Earth. The game blends fast-paced hack-and-slash combat, bullet-hell shooter elements, and multiple narrative routes that reveal different perspectives and endings. This edition includes the base game along with bonus DLC content and cosmetic items, offering the full experience in one package.

title: Persona 5 Royal
description: Persona 5 Royal is an expanded version of the acclaimed turn-based JRPG Persona 5. Players step into the role of a transfer student in Tokyo who leads the Phantom Thieves, a group that explores supernatural palaces to change the hearts of corrupt adults. Royal adds a new semester, additional story content, new characters, improved combat mechanics, quality-of-life upgrades, and more activities to deepen social and dungeon-crawling gameplay. Combining stylish presentation, life simulation, and strategic battles, it is widely regarded as one of the definitive editions of the Persona series.

title: NieR: Automata - Become as Gods Edition
description: NieR: Automata - Become as Gods Edition is an action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic future where humanity has been driven from Earth by alien machines. Players control YoRHa androids 2B, 9S, and A2 as they battle machine lifeforms in a fast-paced combat system combining melee, ranged attacks, and bullet-hell elements. This edition includes the base game along with DLC content, bonus items, and Xbox One enhancements such as 4K support on compatible hardware. The game is known for its multiple story routes, emotional narrative, stylish combat, and distinctive soundtrack.

title: Satisfactory
description: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory-building and automation game set on an alien planet. Players explore the landscape, gather resources, and construct increasingly complex production lines, conveyor systems, vehicles, and power networks to support large-scale industrial expansion. The game emphasizes engineering, logistics, and optimization, allowing players to design sprawling factories while balancing resource extraction, production efficiency, and environmental challenges. It supports both solo play and cooperative multiplayer.

title: Muv-Luv Alternative
description: Muv-Luv Alternative is a visual novel and the direct sequel to Muv-Luv Unlimited. Set in an alternate Earth where humanity is fighting a desperate war against alien invaders known as BETA, the story follows protagonist Takeru Shirogane as he relives events and works with military and political allies to change the course of the conflict. Known for its dramatic storytelling, large-scale mecha battles, emotional character arcs, and extensive worldbuilding, it is widely regarded as one of the most influential visual novels ever made.

title: RimWorld
description: RimWorld is a sci-fi colony simulation and survival game driven by an AI storyteller. Players manage a group of crash-landed survivors on a distant rim-world, building a base, gathering resources, researching technology, and handling food, weather, disease, raiders, and internal morale. The game is known for emergent storytelling, where events and character interactions create unpredictable situations ranging from tragic disasters to bizarre and memorable successes. With deep management systems, mod support, and multiple expansion packs, RimWorld emphasizes strategic planning, adaptability, and long-term colony survival.

title: Therian Saga
description: Therian Saga is a browser-based fantasy massively multiplayer online role-playing game focused on exploration, crafting, and character progression through professions rather than traditional combat. Set in the world of Therian, players create adventurers and develop skills by gathering resources, producing equipment, completing tasks, and traveling across a large open world. The game emphasizes a deep economic system, cooperative play, and strategic management of time and resources. Combat exists, but the core experience centers on building a character through non-linear advancement and interacting with the player-driven marketplace.

title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
description: Kirby and the Forgotten Land is a 3D platform-adventure game in which Kirby explores a mysterious post-apocalyptic world filled with abandoned cities, ruins, and strange wildlife. Players can inhale enemies and objects, copy their abilities, and use them to battle through varied stages while searching for the kidnapped Waddle Dees. The game introduces new mechanics such as Mouthful Mode, allowing Kirby to transform around large objects like cars and vending machines, adding creative traversal and puzzle-solving. It also features cooperative play with Bandana Waddle Dee and a range of upgradeable copy abilities, boss battles, and optional challenges.

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3 FES
description: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3 FES is an expanded version of Persona 3 for the PlayStation 2. It adds new content to the original game, including an enhanced epilogue chapter called 'The Answer,' additional cutscenes, and gameplay refinements. Players balance daily school life, social relationships, and dungeon crawling in Tartarus while fighting shadow creatures using Personas, manifestations of a character's inner psyche. The game is known for its stylish presentation, strong character-driven story, and blend of simulation and turn-based RPG mechanics.

title: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time
description: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time is a third-person action-platformer that follows Ratchet and Clank as they are separated during a battle with the villainous Dr. Nefarious and the mysterious Great Clock. Ratchet searches the galaxy for Clank while uncovering secrets about the Lombaxes, and Clank gains new time-manipulation abilities to solve puzzles and alter the flow of combat. The game blends weapon-based shooting, platforming, exploration, and puzzle-solving, with space travel between planets and upgrades for weapons and gadgets. It is widely regarded as one of the standout entries in the Ratchet & Clank series, praised for its humor, polished gameplay, and strong story.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3
description: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 is a 3D arena fighting game based on the Dragon Ball franchise, featuring a massive roster of characters from Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball GT, and select movie characters. Players battle in large destructible environments with fast aerial combat, beam clashes, transformations, and signature special attacks. The game expands on its predecessor with improved graphics, more characters, refined controls, and a greater emphasis on faithful anime-style action. It also includes day and night stages, weather effects, and a variety of modes such as Dragon Adventure and Battle modes. Widely regarded as one of the most content-rich Dragon Ball fighting games, it is known for its extensive fan service and large-scale battles.

title: It Takes Two
description: It Takes Two is a cooperative action-adventure game designed exclusively for two players. It follows Cody and May, a couple on the verge of divorce who are transformed into dolls by a magic spell and must work together to navigate imaginative, puzzle-filled worlds in order to repair their broken relationship and return to their daughter. The game blends platforming, puzzle solving, and varied gameplay mechanics that change frequently across each chapter, emphasizing teamwork, communication, and coordination. It features a Friend’s Pass system, allowing one player to join for free if the other owns the game. Directed by Josef Fares, It Takes Two is widely praised for its creativity, humor, and inventive co-op design.

title: Enderal: Forgotten Stories
description: Enderal: Forgotten Stories is a standalone total conversion mod for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim that delivers a full role-playing game with its own world, story, lore, and characters. Set in the land of Enderal, it follows a darker, more narrative-driven journey centered on exploration, choice, and psychological themes. The Forgotten Stories expansion adds new quest lines, classes, crafting options, and additional endings, significantly expanding the original Enderal experience. Players can explore a vast open world, engage in deep character progression, and uncover secrets tied to the game’s intricate mythology.

title: Hi-Fi Rush
description: Hi-Fi Rush is a rhythm-action game where combat, movement, and environmental interactions sync to the beat of the music. Players control Chai, a wannabe rock star who gains a music player embedded in his chest and is caught in a corporate conspiracy at Vandelay Technologies. The game blends stylish hack-and-slash combat with timing-based attacks, combos, parries, and special moves that reward playing in rhythm with its energetic soundtrack. It is known for its vibrant cel-shaded art style, comedic tone, and fast-paced, visually expressive presentation.

title: Pizza Tower
description: Pizza Tower is a fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by Wario Land and 1990s cartoon aesthetics. Players control Peppino Spaghetti, an anxious but surprisingly capable pizza chef, as he dashes, jumps, slides, and attacks through bizarre, hand-drawn levels inside a strange tower. The game emphasizes speed, combo chaining, exploration, and skillful movement, rewarding players for maintaining momentum and mastering each stage’s routes and secrets. Its style blends expressive animation, loud humor, and energetic music into a chaotic, highly polished platforming experience.

title: Anomaly Agent
description: Anomaly Agent is a stylish 2D action platformer with light RPG elements, set in a cyberpunk world where anomalies threaten the fabric of reality. Players control Agent 70, an undercover operative investigating a city-wide conspiracy while using fluid melee and gun combat, time-bending abilities, and acrobatic movement to battle enemies and bosses. The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, exploration, and upgrading skills and equipment as the story unfolds.

title: Phoenotopia: Awakening
description: Phoenotopia: Awakening is a side-scrolling action-adventure game with puzzle-solving, exploration, and light RPG elements. Set in a colorful post-apocalyptic world, it follows Gail, a farm girl who sets out to find her missing townsfolk and ends up uncovering the mysteries of a decaying civilization. The game emphasizes hand-crafted areas, secrets, stamina-based combat, platforming challenges, and non-linear progression. It blends classic adventure game design with a detailed, expressive art style and a large world filled with NPCs, side quests, and optional discoveries.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
description: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated is a faithful remake of the 2003 cult-classic 3D platformer. Players control SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy, each with unique abilities, to stop Plankton’s army of rogue robots from taking over Bikini Bottom. The game features colorful platforming, collectible-hunting, puzzle-solving, and boss battles across familiar locations from the SpongeBob universe. It includes updated visuals, improved audio, restored cut content, and a local two-player horde mode inspired by the original release.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
description: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom is an action-adventure game set in a vast open world version of Hyrule. As Link, players explore the land, sky, and underground while using new abilities to build vehicles, solve physics-based puzzles, and combat enemies. It expands on Breath of the Wild with a greater focus on creative freedom, traversal, and player experimentation.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
description: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 is a story-driven Japanese role-playing game set in the world of Aionios, where two nations, Keves and Agnus, are locked in an endless war. Players control Noah and his companions as they uncover the truth behind their conflict while journeying across a vast open-world landscape. The game features real-time combat with positional attacks, class-based character progression, and the innovative Ouroboros system, which allows pairs of characters to merge into powerful forms. As the third mainline entry in the Xenoblade Chronicles series, it blends exploration, emotional storytelling, and large-scale battles, and also connects thematically to earlier games in the franchise.

title: Metroid Dread
description: Metroid Dread is a 2D action-adventure game and the fifth main entry in Nintendo’s Metroid series, following Samus Aran as she investigates a deadly threat on the planet ZDR. Blending exploration, combat, and platforming, the game emphasizes fast-paced movement, precise shooting, and backtracking through interconnected areas as Samus gains new abilities. It introduces E.M.M.I. robots, highly dangerous hunter machines that force stealth and quick reflexes during tense chase sequences. Released for Nintendo Switch, Metroid Dread was praised for its responsive controls, challenging boss fights, atmospheric world design, and modern take on the classic Metroid formula.

title: Theatrhythm Final Bar Line
description: Theatrhythm Final Bar Line is a rhythm action game featuring music from across the Final Fantasy series and other Square Enix titles. Players tap, hold, and slide in time with more than 385 songs in the base game, with additional tracks available through DLC. The game includes multiple modes, including series-based quests, challenge maps, and online multiplayer, letting players build parties of familiar characters and progress through stages set to iconic Final Fantasy music. It also supports a wide roster of characters, each with unique stats and abilities inspired by their home games. Designed as both a celebration of Final Fantasy history and a challenging rhythm experience, it offers extensive fan service through music, characters, and scenes drawn from the franchise's long-running legacy.

title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
description: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is an action role-playing game and the second entry in Square Enix’s Final Fantasy VII remake project. It continues the story of Cloud Strife and his allies after the events of Final Fantasy VII Remake, as they leave Midgar and journey across the world in pursuit of Sephiroth. The game expands the original story with new character moments, side content, and a larger open-world structure featuring exploration, combat, mini-games, and summons. It blends real-time action with tactical command-based mechanics, letting players switch between party members and use synergistic abilities in battle.
